items.titleEn: Every word of Mikel’s pre-Aston Villa presser
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta was back in front of the media for his pre-Aston Villa press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Thursday.
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta was back in front of the media for his pre-Aston Villa press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Thursday.
Our manager looked ahead to Monday night's 8pm kick-off and shared the latest team news.
Here's everything he had to say on the following subjects...
on Ezri Konsa’s availability:Yes he's available. He's trained really well and he will be available for selection.

on if it was a straightforward deal to sign him:I don't get involved in the deals. We get involved in identifying the players and the talent that we believe are going to make us better. But, at the end, when a club sells a player and a club buys a player, it's because everybody's happy with the outcome.

on if Konsa should get a good reaction from Villa fans:Well, I hope so, I don't know. I'm sure that Ezri will think the same way for what he’s done for the club. But, obviously, this is not down to us.

on Bruno Guimaraes’ groin problem:We just managed the last few days with him. He's out on the pitch. He's been doing training sessions. But we need to manage his load to get to Monday in the best possible condition to be able to get selected.
on if he’s potentially available for Monday:Yes, potentially available.

on not seeing Gabriel Jesus in training today:Well, it's something to do with the numbers that we have in the squad at the moment and the way we're managing that kind of situation individually with all the players - they have some personal situations.

on Gabriel Martinelli leaving training ahead of other players today:That's another personal situation that we're dealing with. I think everybody knows and recognises how much we love Gabi. Whatever the outcome is, it will be because everybody agrees to that.

on if he’s had a conversation with Martinelli and Jesus:Yes, for sure. There are those conversations and those conversations go both ways. But I'm very satisfied how these conversations went because I know what is in each other's hearts and the words that come through in those conversation make me really happy. But it's inevitable at some point you need to have certain discussions and say certain things that sometimes are tough.
on if there have been conversations with Julian Alvarez:Don't go there. No, I'm not going to make any comment about any player that is not with us.

on if a player publicly and privately should want to join Arsenal:Publicly, I never ask them. I think it's more privately to get the feeling that if it's something unique, an attachment, a feeling, that they really want to join us, and they have that desire to come and be part of our family.
on if there’s any news on Ethan Nwaneri:No, no news at all.
on if he’s familiar with Spanish press reports that Alvarez didn’t answer our call:You know I'm not going to make any comments about what is said publicly, because I would have a different job.

on the latest on Jurrien Timber and William Saliba:Jurrien is progressing really well. Let's see how he ends up this week. It's the third week in a row that he's been outside and we have increased his load. So he's on the right trajectory, if everything goes well. I think next week we're going to step it up again. Wilo, obviously not much, he’s in conservative load management right now, so that's going to take a while.

on our changes against Coventry and why Gyokeres didn’t come on:For different reasons - some of them physical, some players can’t last 60-90 minutes and we didn’t want to expose them. Some of them are tactical and depend on the game, that’s it.

on Unai Emery’s tough start to the season:He’s one of the most experienced managers in the league, and one of the most successful without a shadow of a doubt. What Villa did last year and how they finished it, it was an incredible season that they had, so it’s just one game and that’s it - I’m sure he will turn it around.

on how to have conversations with players who are moving on:We try to be as clear and transparent as possible and deliver the message as it is. They know from our place the message is coming. If one day I have to give a message that is not that good, the proportion is quite good. I expect that they value that like the things they have done for the club. If the messages are 499 good to one not so good, certainly that one will bear so little in the way I feel about a player.

on if it’s worth having to convince elite players to come here:Explaining what we are, what we are doing and how we expect a player to fit in within our club, and his role in the team, that is certainly the case. They either come by themselves or with a team, whether they have family or people who work with them, I think every player’s system has to be understood. I think everybody around it has to feel it’s the right thing to do.
on if it’s frustrating to wait for situations to develop elsewhere:No. We haven’t had situations like this really - we are really privileged that players want to come to Arsenal.
on his feelings about Martinelli:Gabi is an Arsenal player and that’s it, and I don’t think I should make any more comments about that. I understand the question, but it’s not the moment today.

on if there’s any doubt about throwing Konsa into a game against his former club:No. Well, if I see something different in the player then I may have a question about that, but the way I’ve seen Ezri since day one, knowing his personality really well and through people that have worked with him, I have no concern there.

on if financial rules are a good thing for the Premier League:Well, I prefer not to get into that territory - I think I have enough things around me than to get into that, it’s very complex, and there are other people who are much more prepared and detailed than I am to comment on those.

on if our current strikers have to accept that we could be interested in another one:It’s very simple [for the players]. Whatever they are reading, come and knock on my door if they have a question and I will tell them if it’s true or not. In any position, if you catalogued all the players linked with us in the last three months and put them on the wall, I think we’d need a whole building to put it on. They know there is a lot of speculation with players and if they feel in any doubt over what we think of them when we come to recruit a player, I tell them straight away.

on if any of them have done that:No. Normally I do it. If we go to sign a player in their position, I tell them straight away. These are the plans and we believe the same in you, but the competition is going to increase - I prefer to do it that way.
on how we’re looking to strengthen before the window ends: Can we do that when we close the window? Because it’s not closed yet.

on if he’d be satisfied if we don’t bring in any more players: Today, I’m satisfied. I hope that when it closes, I am even more satisfied because I will be even more convinced the team has put in a great performance against Villa and won the game, and we are in the best possible scenario.

on if this is the best squad he’s had at Arsenal:It’s the best squad that we have or we believe that we could have right now, and that’s it. That’s not the best squad that we’re going to have in a month’s time because hopefully the players will improve, the team will improve and we’ll be better.

on if teams look at us differently now we’re champions: I don’t know how teams are going to behave. I think we need to understand really well what we want, I think we’re very clear in the way we want to approach every single game and then go day by day to prove that we belong where we are.

on where Eberechi Eze fits into things at the moment: Well the great thing that we have in the team is that a lot of players have a huge versatility to play in and occupy different spaces. Ebz is one of them, he plays as a left winger, as a left attacking midfielder, right attacking midfielder, and he can deliver the ball in a great way in those positions. So we will see changes in relation to the opponent, to the relationship that we have in the team, players playing in different positions is going to be needed and I think it’s a real asset that we have in the team.

on our forward players looking fit again:I think it’s a natural reaction [to look for new signings] because we always want more, it looks like, if we sign somebody else. But we already have a lot of great players here in the building. We’re always looking to strengthen and be better and have qualities that we don’t have in the squad. But the main aim, as I said, is to focus on the ones that we have, they are so good.

items.titleZh: 米克尔对阵阿斯顿维拉赛前新闻发布会全记录
items.summaryZh: 周四，阿尔特塔在索巴训练中心出席对阵维拉的赛前发布会。
bodyZh: 周四，米克尔·阿尔特塔在索巴房地产训练中心出席了对阵阿斯顿维拉的赛前新闻发布会，再次面对媒体。
我们的主教练展望了周一晚上8点的开球，并分享了最新的球队消息。
以下是他就以下主题所说的全部内容……
关于埃兹里·孔萨是否可用：是的，他可用。他训练得很好，他将可供选择。
关于签下他是否是一笔直接了当的交易：我不参与交易。我们负责识别我们认为能让我们变得更好的球员和人才。但最终，当一家俱乐部卖出球员、另一家俱乐部买入球员时，那是因为各方都对结果感到满意。
关于孔萨是否应该从维拉球迷那里得到良好反应：嗯，我希望如此，我不知道。我相信埃兹里也会对他为俱乐部所做的一切有同样的看法。但显然，这不由我们决定。
关于布鲁诺·吉马良斯的腹股沟问题：我们最近几天一直在管理他的情况。他已经在球场上了。他一直在参加训练课。但我们需要控制他的负荷，以便在周一以最佳状态被选中。
关于他周一是否可能复出：是的，有可能可用。
关于今天没有在训练中看到加布里埃尔·热苏斯：嗯，这与我们目前阵中的球员人数有关，以及我们如何与所有球员单独处理这种情况——他们有一些个人情况。
关于加布里埃尔·马丁内利今天提前离开训练：那是我们正在处理的另一个个人情况。我想每个人都知道并认可我们是多么爱加比。无论结果如何，那都是因为每个人都同意这一点。
关于他是否与马丁内利和热苏斯有过交谈：是的，当然。有这样的对话，而且是双向的。但我对这些对话的进展非常满意，因为我知道彼此心中的想法，那些对话中传来的话语让我真的很开心。但在某个时刻，你不可避免地需要进行某些讨论，说一些有时很艰难的话。
关于是否与胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯有过对话：别提那个。不，我不会对任何不在我们这里的球员发表任何评论。
关于球员在公开和私下是否都应该想加盟阿森纳：公开方面，我从不要求他们。我认为更多是在私下里感受，是否有一种独特、依恋、感觉，他们真的想加入我们，并且有来到我们家中的愿望。
关于伊桑·恩瓦内里是否有任何消息：没有，完全没有消息。
关于他是否熟悉西班牙媒体报道阿尔瓦雷斯没有接听我们的电话：你知道我不会对公开言论发表任何评论，因为那我就会有别的工作了。
关于尤里安·廷贝尔和威廉·萨利巴的最新情况：尤里安进展得很好。让我们看看他本周结束时的情况。这是他连续第三周在室外训练，我们增加了他的负荷。所以他正走在正确的轨道上，如果一切顺利的话。我想下周我们会再次加强。威洛（萨利巴的昵称）显然进展不多，他目前处于保守的负荷管理阶段，所以那需要一段时间。
关于我们对阵考文垂时的轮换以及为什么于厄克雷斯没有上场：出于不同的原因——有些是身体原因，有些球员无法坚持60-90分钟，我们不想让他们冒险。有些是战术原因，取决于比赛情况，就是这样。
关于乌奈·埃梅里赛季初的艰难开局：他是联赛中最有经验的主教练之一，无疑也是最成功的主教练之一。维拉去年所做的一切以及他们最终的方式，那是他们度过的一个不可思议的赛季，所以这只是（赛季的）一场比赛而已——我相信他会扭转局面的。
关于如何与即将离队的球员进行对话：我们尽量做到清晰透明，如实传达信息。他们知道信息来自我们这里。如果有一天我必须传达一个不太好的信息，（好的和不好的）比例是相当好的。我期待他们像珍惜为俱乐部所做的一切一样珍惜这一点。如果信息是499条好的和1条不太好的，那么那一条不好的在我对球员的感觉中显然无足轻重。
关于是否值得去说服精英球员来到这里：解释我们是谁、我们在做什么、我们期望球员如何融入我们的俱乐部以及他在球队中的角色，这当然是必要的。他们要么自己来，要么带团队来，不管他们是否有家人或与他们一起工作的人，我认为每个球员的系统都需要被理解。我认为周围的每个人都必须感觉到这是正确的做法。
关于等待其他地方的情况发展是否会让人沮丧：不会。我们真的没有遇到过这样的情况——我们很荣幸球员们想加盟阿森纳。
关于他对马丁内利的看法：加比是一名阿森纳球员，就是这样，我认为我不应该对此发表更多评论。我理解这个问题，但今天不是时候。
关于让孔萨对阵他的前东家是否有任何疑虑：没有。嗯，如果我看到球员有什么不同，我可能会有疑问，但自从第一天起我看到的埃兹里，我非常了解他的性格，并通过与他共事过的人了解，我对此没有任何担忧。
关于财务规则对英超是否是一件好事：嗯，我宁愿不涉足那个领域——我想我周围有足够多的事情，不想再卷入其中，那非常复杂，而且还有其他人比我更有准备、更详细地来评论这些。
关于我们现有的前锋是否必须接受我们可能对另一名前锋感兴趣：这很简单（对于球员来说）。无论他们读到什么，如果有疑问，就来敲我的门，我会告诉他们是否属实。在任何位置上，如果你把过去三个月里与我们联系的所有球员编成目录贴在墙上，我想我们需要一整栋楼来贴。他们知道有很多关于球员的猜测，如果他们对我们招募球员时对他们的看法有任何疑虑，我会直接告诉他们。
关于他们中是否有人这样做过：没有。通常是我这样做。如果我们去签下他们位置上的球员，我会直接告诉他们。这些是计划，我们同样信任你，但竞争会增加——我更喜欢这样做。
关于我们是否希望在转会窗关闭前加强阵容：我们能在关窗时再谈这个吗？因为现在还没关呢。
关于如果我们不再引进球员，他是否会感到满意：今天，我很满意。我希望在转会窗关闭时，我更加满意，因为我会更加确信球队在对阵维拉的比赛中表现出色并赢得了比赛，我们处于最佳状态。
关于这是否是他在阿森纳拥有过的最好的阵容：这是我们目前拥有或我们认为目前能拥有的最好阵容，就是这样。这不是我们一个月后将拥有的最好阵容，因为希望球员们会进步，球队会进步，我们会变得更好。
关于现在我们是冠军，对手是否用不同的眼光看我们：我不知道对手会如何表现。我认为我们需要真正明白我们想要什么，我认为我们非常清楚我们对待每场比赛的方式，然后日复一日地证明我们属于现在的地位。
关于埃贝雷奇·埃泽目前适合什么位置：嗯，我们队中的一大优势是很多球员具有很强的多面性，可以在不同空间踢球。埃贝就是其中之一，他可以踢左边锋、左攻击型中场、右攻击型中场，并且在这些位置上他都能很好地送出传球。所以我们会看到根据对手、根据队内关系的改变，球员踢不同位置将会是需要的，我认为这是我们队中的真正资产。
关于我们的前锋球员看起来恢复健康：我认为（寻找新援）是一种自然反应，因为我们总想要更多，看起来如果我们签下其他人。但我们已经在这里有很多优秀的球员。我们总是在寻求补强、变得更好，并拥有我们在阵容中没有的特质。但正如我所说，主要目标是专注于我们现有的球员，他们非常优秀。

items.titleEn: Arteta issues update on Bruno, Timber and Saliba
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta has given his latest team news before taking on Aston Villa
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has provided an update on summer signing Bruno Guimaraes ahead of our trip to Aston Villa next Monday.
The Brazilian played in our 3-0 win over Manchester City in the Community Shield before missing our opening Premier League clash of the campaign against Coventry.
Asked about Bruno's availability for the trip to Villa Park, Mikel told the press: "Yes, potentially available.

"We just managed the last few days with him. He's out on the pitch. He's been doing training sessions. But we need to manage his load to get to Monday in the best possible condition to be able to get selected."
One player who could make his debut for us in familiar territory is Ezri Konsa.
The defender joined us from Aston Villa last week and could be set for a quick return to Villa Park.
"Yes he's available," Mikel said. "He's trained really well and he will be available for selection."
When asked if he had any concerns about using the England international against his former club, our boss was in little doubt about our number 15's capabilities.

"If I see something different in the player then I may have a question about that, but the way I’ve seen Ezri since day one, knowing his personality really well and through people that have worked with him, I have no concern there."
Our boss was quizzed about the fitness of Jurrien Timber and William Saliba, who have yet to feature this season.

Providing an update on the defensive duo, Mikel said: "Jurrien is progressing really well. Let's see how he ends up this week. It's the third week in a row that he's been outside and we have increased his load. So he's on the right trajectory, if everything goes well, I think next week we're going to step it up again.
"Wilo, obviously not much, he’s in conservative load management right now, so that's going to take a while."

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔通报布鲁诺、廷伯和萨利巴近况
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔在迎战阿斯顿维拉前给出了最新的球队消息。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔在球队下周一客场挑战阿斯顿维拉之前，更新了夏季新援布鲁诺·吉马良斯的情况。
这位巴西球员在社区盾对阵曼城的比赛中出场，帮助球队3-0获胜，但缺席了球队本赛季英超首轮对阵考文垂的比赛。
当被问及布鲁诺能否出战客场对阵维拉公园时，阿尔特塔对媒体说：“是的，他可能可以上场。”
“我们刚刚对他在过去几天进行了管理。他已经在场上进行训练了。但我们需要控制他的负荷，以便在周一达到最佳状态，从而能够入选大名单。”
一位可能在熟悉场地迎来我们首秀的球员是埃兹里·孔萨。
这位后卫上周从阿斯顿维拉转会至我们，可能将迅速重返维拉公园。
“是的，他可以上场，”阿尔特塔说。“他训练得很好，他将进入比赛名单。”
当被问及是否担心这位英格兰国脚对阵老东家时，我们的主教练对这位15号球员的能力毫不怀疑。
“如果我在球员身上看到了一些不同的东西，那我可能会有疑问，但自从第一天起我观察到的埃兹里，我非常了解他的性格，也通过与他共事过的人有所了解，我对此没有顾虑。”
我们的主教练被问及尤里安·廷伯和威廉·萨利巴的身体状况，他们本赛季尚未出场。
在更新这对防守组合的情况时，阿尔特塔说：“尤里安恢复得很好。让我们看看他本周的情况。这是他连续第三周在室外训练，我们增加了他的负荷。所以他的恢复轨迹是正确的，如果一切顺利，我想下周我们会再次加大训练强度。
“至于威洛，显然情况不多，他现在处于保守的负荷管理阶段，所以这需要一段时间。”

items.titleEn: Mikel on Villa, Konsa and proving ourselves
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta spoke about Aston Villa, Unai Emery and Ezri Konsa in his pre-match press conference at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Thursday afternoon
bodyEn: Our first away trip of the season sees us travel to Villa Park on Bank Holiday Monday for an 8pm kick-off against Unai Emery’s side.
We’ve been in a buoyant mood off the back of our opening day 3-0 win at home to Coventry City, while for Villa it’s been quite the opposite following their chastening 4-0 loss at Brighton.

Reflecting on our former manager’s tough start to the season in his pre-match press conference, Mikel Arteta said: “He's one of the most experienced managers in the league and one of the most successful, without a question of a doubt.
“Look at how they did last year, how they finished it and the incredible season that they had. It's just a game and that's it. I'm sure he will turn it around.”
Much has been made of Villa’s departures throughout the summer, including our own signing of Ezri Konsa, who could be in line to make his debut against his former club, our head coach explained.

Asked if there’s any doubt about throwing him into the starting line-up for such a fixture, Mikel said: “No, well if I see something different in the player, maybe I question that, but the way I've seen Ezri since day one, knowing his personality really well, and with all the feedback that I got from all the people that have worked with him, that's nothing that concerns me there.”

Later on in his pre-match press conference, the boss was asked if our current squad is the best he’s ever had at Arsenal, and if teams perceive us differently now that we’re coming to play them as 2025/26 champions.

“It's the best squad that we have or we believe that we could have right now and that's it,” he replied. “And it's not the best squad that we're going to have in a month's time because hopefully the players will improve, the team will improve and we'll be better.

“I don't know how teams are going to behave. I think we need to understand really well what we want. I think we're very clear in the way we want to approach every single game and then go day by day to prove that we belong where we are.”

items.titleZh: 米克尔谈维拉、孔萨及证明自己
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔在赛前发布会上谈及阿斯顿维拉、埃梅里和孔萨。
bodyZh: 我们本赛季的第一个客场之旅将在银行假日周一前往维拉公园，晚上8点对阵乌奈·埃梅里的球队。
在首日主场3-0战胜考文垂后，我们心情愉悦，而维拉则截然相反，他们刚刚在布莱顿遭遇了4-0的惨痛失利。
在赛前新闻发布会上回顾我们前主教练本赛季的艰难开局时，米克尔·阿尔特塔表示：“毫无疑问，他是联赛中最有经验的主教练之一，也是最成功的主教练之一。”
“看看他们去年的表现，他们如何结束赛季以及他们度过的精彩赛季。这只是场比赛，仅此而已。我相信他会扭转局面。”
关于维拉整个夏天的离队球员有很多讨论，包括我们签下埃兹里·孔萨，他有可能在对阵老东家的比赛中上演首秀，我们的主教练解释道。
当被问及是否怀疑让他在这样一场比赛中进入首发阵容时，米克尔说：“不，如果我在球员身上看到不同的东西，我可能会质疑，但自从第一天见到埃兹里以来，我了解他的性格，而且从所有与他共事过的人那里得到的反馈来看，我对此毫不担心。”
在赛前新闻发布会的稍后部分，这位主帅被问及我们目前的阵容是否是他执教阿森纳以来最好的，以及作为2025/26赛季冠军去比赛，球队是否对我们有不同的看法。
“这是我们目前拥有的或者我们认为可能拥有的最好阵容，就这样，”他回答。“而且这不是我们一个月后将会拥有的最好阵容，因为希望球员会进步，球队会提高，我们会变得更好。”
“我不知道球队会如何表现。我认为我们需要真正清楚自己想要什么。我认为我们非常清楚每场比赛的应对方式，然后日复一日地去证明我们属于我们所在的位置。”

bodyEn: Every transfer window has at least one saga that dominates. Barcola’s potential move to Liverpool has been that story this summer. Given Liverpool are crying out for a right-winger to replace Mohamed Salah, one of their greatest players, it may seem surprising their attention has been fixed on Barcola, who has spent 77% of his minutes at Paris Saint-Germain on the left side of the attack. However, rather than signing a like-for-like replacement, Liverpool seem keen to bring in a fast forward who is willing to press and can play on either flank.

Andoni Iraola’s approach is built on relentless pressing and fast transitions; Barcola’s numbers suggest he would fit in perfectly. The 23-year-old’s peak sprint speed of 32.7kmh was the fourth-highest in Europe’s top five leagues last season; he made 109 runs in behind in the Champions League – among the highest in the competition; and he won back the ball in the final third more often than any Liverpool player (per 90 minutes). With Salah gone, Liverpool need goals; Barcola scored 11 in Ligue 1 last season and 14 the year before. He looks tailor-made to be the kind of vertical threat Iraola needs.

Despite signing Viktor Gyökeres for £63.7m last summer, Arsenal find themselves in the familiar position of needing to solve their supposed striker problem. That sounds strange given they won the Premier League title and reached the Champions League final last season. They were also the second-top scorers in the Premier League, after Manchester City.

However, they scored 71 goals , the lowest by the champions since Leicester a decade ago, and 29 of them came from set pieces – a Premier League record. Gyökeres was their top scorer in the league with 14 goals – fewer than Erling Haaland (27), Igor Thiago (22), Antoine Semenyo (17), Ollie Watkins (16), João Pedro (15) and Morgan Gibbs-White (15).

Thierry Henry knows what it takes to score goals for Arsenal. When the club’s record-scorer picks out a striker he likes, it is worth listening. “One of my favourite nines out there is Julián Álvarez,” he said. “Putting pressure, playing alone, dropping low, whatever you want – score free-kicks, hold the ball. He played at the Olympic Games, the Copa América, but I don’t hear him saying he’s tired. He plays in everything and, the way he does it, I like him.”

This is what Arsenal need: a versatile forward who is almost a blend of Kai Havertz and Gyökeres. The 26-year-old can hold up the ball or drop deep to link up play and he can also hurt teams with his pace and penalty-area instinct. Just as importantly, he presses relentlessly from the front. Álvarez applied more pressures per 90 minutes, 82.8, than any other player in the Champions League last season. He also has Premier League experience, having been a part of the City squad that won the treble.

Atlético Madrid have fought off attention from Barcelona this summer and insist Álvarez is not for sale, but he has said he wants to leave. Losing him to Arsenal would be better than seeing him join a direct rival in La Liga.

Rodri’s move to Barcelona has stripped Manchester City of more than just a Ballon d’Or winner. It has removed the foundation on which their entire possession-based approach has been built for years. It now falls to Enzo Maresca to pick up the pieces and find a solution after losing the man who was voted the best player at the World Cup.

Rather than trying to replace the irreplaceable, it seems the Italian is attempting to divide Rodri’s influence through a collection of players. No one else possesses Rodri’s defensive positioning and ability to read the game, the underlying qualities that allowed City to be on the front foot so often without fear of being caught in transition. Elliot Anderson, the club’s record £116m addition, will be asked to take on Rodri’s anchoring duties. He won possession more than any other player in the Premier League, 306, and had the most touches, 3,323.

Fernández would be the next piece in the puzzle. The Argentina midfielder would offer City’s midfield some of the qualities they miss on the ball: the ability to dictate from deep, move up the pitch and find forward passes through the lines. He ranked seventh among Premier League central midfielders for forward passes last season and his instinct for timing late arrivals into the area makes him a constant threat. Fernández is more of an attacking threat than Rodri – he scored 10 goals in the league last season – and could form a deadly duo if paired with Anderson.

If Barcola joins Liverpool, Gakpo could be shown the door. Liverpool fans have grown increasingly weary of the sight of him cutting inside on to his right foot and blazing one over the bar. As deadline day approaches, two Premier League rivals are interested in him.

Spurs have been on a spending spree and have apparently agreed personal terms with Gakpo. The 27-year-old is also reportedly attracting interest from Manchester City, who have said goodbye to Rodri, Tijjani Reijnders, Sávio, Bernardo Silva, Nico González and Omar Marmoush. Gakpo is coming off a disappointing season – like many at Liverpool – but his underlying numbers are impressive.

Gakpo’s stats in the Premier League last season – seven goals, five assists, 8.59 xG, 87 shots and 10 big chances created – compare favourably to the forwards on the books at Spurs. At 6ft 4in, he is a threat in the air and he can play as a centre-forward. We should also remember that he scored 18 goals and provided seven assists in all competitions in 2024-25, when Liverpool won the title. He also had a good World Cup for the Netherlands, scoring three goals in four games.
This is an article by WhoScored

items.titleZh: 夏季转会窗最后一周的五大转会看点
items.summaryZh: 巴尔科拉、阿尔瓦雷斯、恩佐·费尔南德斯和加克波可能在未来几天转会。
bodyZh: 每个转会窗口至少有一个主导故事。今年夏天，巴尔科拉可能转会利物浦就是这个故事。鉴于利物浦急需一名右边锋来取代他们最伟大的球员之一穆罕默德·萨拉赫，他们却把注意力集中在巴尔科拉身上，这似乎令人惊讶——巴尔科拉在巴黎圣日耳曼有77%的时间是在进攻左路度过的。然而，利物浦似乎并不是想签下一名同类型替代者，而是希望引进一名速度快、愿意施压且能胜任两翼的前锋。

安多尼·伊劳拉的战术体系建立在持续逼抢和快速转换之上；巴尔科拉的数据表明他会完美契合。这位23岁球员的最高冲刺速度达到32.7公里/小时，在上赛季欧洲五大联赛中排名第四；他在欧冠联赛中完成109次身后跑动，在赛事中名列前茅；而且他每90分钟在前场夺回球权的次数比任何利物浦球员都多。随着萨拉赫离开，利物浦需要进球；巴尔科拉上赛季在法甲打入11球，前一个赛季打入14球。他看起来就是为伊劳拉所需的垂直威胁量身打造的。
尽管去年夏天以6370万英镑签下了维克托·哲凯赖什，阿森纳仍然发现自己处于熟悉的位置，需要解决所谓的锋线问题。这听起来很奇怪，因为他们上赛季赢得了英超冠军并闯入了欧冠决赛。他们还是英超进球第二多的球队，仅次于曼城。
然而，他们只打进了71球，这是自十年前莱斯特城以来冠军球队的最低进球数，其中29球来自定位球——创下了英超纪录。哲凯赖什在联赛中以14球成为队内最佳射手——少于埃尔林·哈兰德（27球）、伊戈尔·蒂亚戈（22球）、安东尼·塞梅尼奥（17球）、奥利·沃特金斯（16球）、若昂·佩德罗（15球）和摩根·吉布斯-怀特（15球）。
蒂埃里·亨利知道为阿森纳进球需要什么。当这位俱乐部最佳射手挑选他喜欢的射手时，值得倾听。他说：“我最喜欢的九号之一就是胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯。施压、单打独斗、回撤，无论你想要什么——罚任意球、控球。他参加了奥运会、美洲杯，但我没听到他说累。他参加所有比赛，而且他的方式，我喜欢。”
这就是阿森纳需要的：一名多面手前锋，几乎融合了凯·哈弗茨和哲凯赖什的特点。这位26岁的球员可以背身拿球，也可以回撤串联进攻，还能用速度和禁区本能威胁对手。同样重要的是，他从锋线开始持续施压。阿尔瓦雷斯上赛季在欧冠中每90分钟施压82.8次，比任何其他球员都多。他还有英超经验，曾是曼城三冠王阵容的一员。
马德里竞技今年夏天抵挡住了巴塞罗那的关注，并坚称阿尔瓦雷斯不会出售，但他已经表示想离开。失去他给阿森纳，比看到他在西甲加盟直接竞争对手要好。
罗德里转会巴塞罗那，让曼城失去的不仅仅是一位金球奖得主。它移除了球队多年来整个控球战术体系赖以建立的基础。现在，由恩佐·马雷斯卡来收拾残局，在失去这位世界杯最佳球员后寻找解决方案。
这位意大利人似乎不是试图取代不可替代者，而是试图通过一组球员来分担罗德里在场上的影响力。没有人拥有罗德里那样的防守站位和阅读比赛能力，这些底层特质让曼城能够经常占据主动而不必担心被打反击。俱乐部创纪录的1.16亿英镑新援埃利奥特·安德森将被要求承担罗德里的拖后组织职责。他在英超中夺回球权次数最多，达到306次，触球次数也最多，为3323次。
费尔南德斯将是拼图的下一块。这位阿根廷中场将为曼城中场提供一些他们在控球时所缺少的特质：从深处组织、向前推进、通过防线寻找前传球。上赛季他在英超中前传球排名中第七，而且他适时前插禁区的能力使他成为持续的威胁。费尔南德斯比罗德里更具进攻威胁——他上赛季在联赛中打入10球——如果与安德森搭档，可以形成致命组合。
如果巴尔科拉加盟利物浦，加克波可能会被出售。利物浦球迷对他在右路内切后右脚射门偏出的画面越来越感到厌倦。随着截止日临近，两家英超对手对他感兴趣。
热刺一直在疯狂引援，据说已经与加克波谈妥了个人条款。据报道，这位27岁的球员也引起了曼城的兴趣，曼城已经送别了罗德里、蒂贾尼·赖因德斯、萨维奥、贝尔纳多·席尔瓦、尼科·冈萨雷斯和奥马尔·马穆什。加克波刚刚经历了一个令人失望的赛季——就像利物浦的许多人一样——但他的底层数据令人印象深刻。
加克波上赛季在英超的数据——7球5助攻、8.59的进球期望值、87次射门和10次创造重大机会——与热刺阵中的前锋相比毫不逊色。他身高6英尺4英寸，空中优势明显，也能踢中锋。我们还应该记得，在2024-25赛季利物浦赢得联赛冠军时，他在各项赛事中打入18球并送出7次助攻。他代表荷兰参加世界杯的表现也很好，四场比赛打入三球。

items.summaryEn: Manchester United’s under-powered attack, Brentford’s £39m bargain and Dewsbury-Hall delivers for EvertonArsenal’s treatment of Gabriel Martinelli has been questioned by Ian Wright after the Brazil forward was left out of their squad for Friday’s opening game against Coventry. Martinelli turned down a move to Galatasaray last week after Arsenal had agreed a fee with the Turkish club and the former striker Wright revealed on Sky Sports after the Coventry game that no one at the club has spoken to the 25-year-old to discuss his future. “I know they might want him out, and a lot of people might say: ‘Yeah, it’s time for him to move him on.’ But there’s ways of doing that and it should suit him as well, how he wants to leave,” said Wright. “He’s done enough with this squad to be treated with a little bit more respect than he’s being treated with at the moment.” Ed AaronsMatch report: Arsenal

Match report: Arsenal 3-0 Coventry
The Guardian's daily football game, On the ball, is now live in the app for both iOS and Android. Can you identify the Premier League star from the clues?

It was only one game after 278 for Aston Villa, accumulated over the previous six seasons – a period in which Ollie Watkins has scored 108 goals and made himself one of the most popular players in the club’s Premier League history. But the rules are the rules. Nobody can refuse to play and emerge without a mark against their character. This is the charge against Watkins, brought in none-too-subtle fashion by Unai Emery after Villa’s 4-0 defeat at Brighton – a match that Watkins missed as he considers an approach from Al-Hilal. We do not yet have Watkins’s side of the story. Or that of his agent. But given Emery had no other available No 9, it feels pretty clear the manager did not choose to omit Watkins. Villa claim they are not close to any agreement with Al-Hilal, having rejected more than one offer from them. Perish the thought that this could drag on. Villa have one more game before the window shuts – against Arsenal at home next Monday night. David Hytner
Match report: Brighton 4-0 Aston Villa

Michael Carrick was limited in his options during Manchester United’s opener because Benjamin Sesko was unable to feature at any point in pre-season but Matheus Cunha was completely ineffective as a false 9. Hull’s back three enjoyed a very quiet lunchtime as they returned to the Premier League. Cunha did not embrace the physical battle and went missing, leaving United with barely any presence in the final third as they failed to threaten their opponents. Sesko was brought on to change the dynamic but was equally ineffectual, while his fellow striker Joshua Zirkzee was left on the bench, implying how little trust the coaches have in him. Carrick needs to get Sesko up to speed and sell Zirkzee soon, freeing up funds to find a better alternative if United are to compete this season, especially with the false 9 tactic looking flawed. Will Unwin
Match report: Hull 2-0 Manchester United

Manchester United were impressively unthreatening in their approach to losing at Hull. There was the odd half-baked attempt at scoring or putting a cross into a dangerous area but nothing that made the highlights reel. This was unfortunate for the Hull goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis, who had an impressive, if somewhat uncomplicated, debut between the sticks. United should have made a greater effort to test the £20m signing from Olympiakos. What duties the Greek international was forced to do were carried out with ease, instilling confidence in the defence in front of him. If he continues to look so calm and assured, Tzolakis could prove himself one of the smartest signings of the season. “We bought him and we spent some money there,” Sergej Jakirovic said. “He’s a national-team player of Greece, an Olympiakos player. If you’re following Greek football, Olympiakos, it’s a huge stress, huge pressure there, and he’s used to it. For him, I think this is like a cup of tea.” WU

Rayan Cherki wrested the three points in a cameo that consisted of the corner for Marc Guéhi’s equaliser and the cute pass for Josko Gvardiol’s winner. Enzo Maresca gave an insight into the Frenchman’s disquiet at not starting. “Rayan is quite a nice and clear boy, if he is not happy he wants to show it. If he’s next to me and he’s not happy, you all realise that he is not happy because he is doing anything just to show that he is not happy. I know that he was not happy today but at the end I had to take a decision,” said the manager. Jamie Jackson
Match report: Manchester City 2-1 Bournemouth

At a time when some Premier League are willing to spend more than £100m on midfielders there is unlikely to be a better bargain than Mamadou Sangaré. Brentford’s new signing was excellent for Lens last season and was outstanding on his debut against Tottenham. Sangaré dominated midfield, even with Spurs able to field upwards of £175m worth of talent in Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes, and his performance raised the question of why the league’s bigger clubs are not willing to look further afield for signings. Brentford, after all, paid only £39m for Sangaré. Yet it seems inevitable there will be clubs willing to pay double the price if he has a good first season in England. Jacob Steinberg

Kick off your evenings with the Guardian's take on the world of football
after newsletter promotion
Match report: Brentford 3-0 Tottenham

As gut-wrenching as it must have been for Newcastle fans to see their side concede a stoppage-time penalty to Liverpool, at least they can take comfort that it wasn’t Alexander Isak that scored the Reds’ dramatic equaliser from 12 yards. The former Newcastle striker had a torrid time on his return to St James’ Park – booed at every touch, crunched by Lewis Hall in the tackle and sending his only real chance of note into orbit – but he would surely have fancied taking his revenge with the last kick of the game before Dominik Szoboszlai converted the 99th-minute spot-kick. Worryingly, Isak is lacking the fluency that convinced Liverpool to spend £125m last summer and with Hugo Ekitiké still sidelined with a long-term injury, Andoni Iraola doesn’t have a natural replacement at No 9. If Liverpool are to be successful this season, Isak has to turn it on. Michael Butler
Match report: Newcastle 2-2 Liverpool

A defensive tactical shift from the Ipswich Town manager, Gary O’Neil, demonstrated the changing nature of the Premier League. O’Neil, an astute reader of the game, chose to play the tall centre-back Dara O’Shea at right-back to counter the threat of set pieces that have become so prevalent, in Ipswich’s surprise win against Sunderland. “Aerially the Premier League is such a test now, from long throws and set pieces,” O’Neil said. “To have three centre-half types in your back four helps us from set pieces, size-wise.” In the first season since Pep Guardiola departed, the top flight is already shifting away from his neat, passing football to a different beast. Sam Cunningham
Match report: Ipswich 2-1 Sunderland

David Moyes felt his young Everton team might have been uncomfortable chasing the game against Crystal Palace and were therefore indebted to Jordan Pickford’s save from Eddie Nketiah, plus Jean-Philippe Mateta’s finishing, for not having to do so. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall’s guidance was instrumental too. The performance of both teams altered once the midfielder imposed himself, while his superb strike beyond Dean Henderson underlined the quality of a player who will be crucial to Everton’s aspirations. “I want to be better than last season,” said Dewsbury-Hall, who delivered eight goals and four assists in his first Premier League campaign at Everton. “That’s not just goals and assists, it’s my overall play. A couple of years ago I probably wasn’t getting goals and assists but was influential in play. I want to mix that together and when you do that that’s when you become a complete midfielder. I know I have the ability to do it so fingers crossed I do.” Andy Hunter
Match report: Everton 2-0 Crystal Palace

Optimism abounds at Leeds. An encouraging opening-day victory at Nottingham Forest gave credence to the idea that Daniel Farke’s side are capable of cementing their place in the league. Last season, survival was the aim but after investing about £80m to sign James Trafford, Tarik Muharemovic and Nico Elvedi, plus Harry Wilson on a free, they are seeking to build on a 14th-placed finish. Leeds and Forest, who meet again in the Carabao Cup on Tuesday, have both been linked with a move for Chelsea’s Liam Delap; a striker to share the load with Dominic Calvert-Lewin would surely elevate Farke’s side. “If we want to establish ourselves and after a few years perhaps speak about something else, then we need to add individual quality,” Farke said. “The last time this club was able to have two solid seasons at this level, you will perhaps find it in black-and-white photos.” Ben Fisher
Match report: Nottingham Forest 0-1 Leeds

阿斯顿维拉在上赛季之前的六个赛季中累积了278场联赛出场，在此期间奥利·沃特金斯打进了108球，成为俱乐部英超历史上最受欢迎的球员之一。但规则就是规则。没有人能在拒绝出场后不被贴上性格污点。这是沃特金斯面临的指控，在维拉0-4输给布莱顿之后，乌奈·埃梅里以毫不隐晦的方式提出了这一点——沃特金斯因考虑来自利雅得新月的报价而缺席了这场比赛。我们尚未听到沃特金斯或其经纪人的说法。但考虑到埃梅里没有其他可用的9号球员，很明显主教练并非主动选择弃用沃特金斯。维拉声称他们尚未与利雅得新月达成任何协议，并且已经拒绝了对方多份报价。但愿这不会拖太久。维拉在转会窗口关闭前还有一场比赛——下周一晚上主场对阵阿森纳。大卫·海特纳
比赛报告：布莱顿4-0阿斯顿维拉

迈克尔·卡里克在曼联揭幕战中可选人员有限，因为本杰明·塞斯科在整个季前赛中都未能出场，而马特乌斯·库尼亚作为伪九号完全无效。赫尔城的三中卫在重返英超的首个午餐时段比赛中过得非常安静。库尼亚没有融入身体对抗，比赛消失，导致曼联在进攻三区几乎毫无存在感，未能威胁到对手。塞斯科替补上场试图改变局面，但同样没有效果，而另一位前锋约书亚·齐尔克泽则坐在替补席上，这表明教练们对他有多不信任。卡里克需要尽快让塞斯科进入状态，并尽快卖掉齐尔克泽，腾出资金寻找更好的替代者，如果曼联本赛季要竞争的话，尤其是伪九号战术看起来存在缺陷。威尔·温温
比赛报告：赫尔城2-0曼联

曼联在客场输给赫尔城的过程中，其进攻方式令人印象深刻地缺乏威胁。偶尔有几次半心半意的射门尝试或传中，但都没有进入精彩集锦。这对赫尔城门将康斯坦蒂诺斯·佐拉基斯来说是不幸的，他的首秀令人印象深刻，尽管并不复杂。曼联本应付出更大努力来考验这位从奥林匹亚科斯以2000万英镑签下的门将。这位希腊国脚被迫做的扑救都处理得轻松自如，给身后的防线注入了信心。如果他能继续保持如此冷静和自信，佐拉基斯可能会成为本赛季最精明的签约之一。“我们买下他并花了一些钱，”塞尔盖·亚基罗维奇说，“他是希腊国家队球员，奥林匹亚科斯球员。如果你关注希腊足球，奥林匹亚科斯，那里压力巨大，他已经习惯了。对他来说，我觉得这就像喝杯茶一样。”威尔·温温
拉扬·谢尔基在替补出场后抢下了三分，包括为马克·格伊的扳平球送出角球，以及为约什科·格瓦尔迪奥尔的制胜球送出精妙传球。恩佐·马雷斯卡透露了这位法国人对未能首发的沮丧。“拉扬是个相当直率坦诚的男孩，如果他不高兴，他会表现出来。如果他在我身边不高兴，你们都会意识到他不高兴，因为他会做任何事来表现出他的不满。我知道他今天不高兴，但最终我必须做出决定。”主教练说道。杰米·杰克逊
比赛报告：曼城2-1伯恩茅斯

在有些英超俱乐部愿意为中场球员花费超过1亿英镑的时候，恐怕很难有比马马杜·桑加雷更划算的交易了。布伦特福德的新援上赛季在朗斯表现极佳，并在对阵热刺的处子秀中表现出色。桑加雷完全控制了中场，即使热刺能够派出价值超过1.75亿英镑的桑德罗·托纳利和马特乌斯·费尔南德斯组合，他的表现也引发了一个问题：为什么联赛中的大俱乐部不愿意将引援眼光放得更远？毕竟布伦特福德只为桑加雷支付了3900万英镑。然而，如果他在英格兰的第一个赛季表现出色，似乎肯定会有俱乐部愿意出双倍的价格。雅各布·斯坦伯格

尽管纽卡斯尔球迷看到球队在补时阶段送给利物浦点球必感痛心，但至少他们可以感到安慰的是，罚进点球帮助红军戏剧性扳平的不是亚历山大·伊萨克。这位前纽卡斯尔前锋回到圣詹姆斯公园球场时度日如年——每次触球都被嘘，被刘易斯·霍尔铲球重创，他唯一真正的机会也飞上了看台——但在多米尼克·索博斯洛伊在第99分钟罚入点球之前，他本有机会在比赛最后时刻完成复仇。令人担忧的是，伊萨克缺乏上赛季那种让利物浦愿意在去年夏天花费1.25亿英镑签下他的状态。考虑到雨果·埃基蒂克仍因长期伤病缺阵，安多尼·伊劳拉在9号位没有天然替补。如果利物浦本赛季想取得成功，伊萨克必须找回状态。迈克尔·巴特勒
比赛报告：纽卡斯尔2-2利物浦

伊普斯维奇主教练加里·奥尼尔的防守战术转变展示了英超联赛的变化。奥尼尔对比赛有敏锐的洞察力，他在伊普斯维奇意外战胜桑德兰的比赛中，选择让高大的中后卫达拉·奥谢出任右后卫，以应对如今非常普遍的定位球威胁。“现在英超的空中对抗考验很大，无论是长掷球还是定位球，”奥尼尔说，“后防线上有三个中后卫类型有助于我们在定位球上占据尺寸优势。”在瓜迪奥拉离开后的第一个赛季，顶级联赛已经开始从他那套讲究传控的足球风格转向了另一种不同的面貌。萨姆·坎宁安
比赛报告：伊普斯维奇2-1桑德兰

大卫·莫耶斯认为他年轻的埃弗顿队在对阵水晶宫的比赛中可能因追分而感到不自在，因此他们欠乔丹·皮克福德一次扑救埃迪·恩凯蒂亚射门的恩情，再加上让-菲利普·马特塔的射门，才不必面临落后局面。基尔南·迪尤斯伯里-霍尔的引导作用至关重要。一旦这位中场球员掌控比赛，两队的状态都发生了变化，而他出色的远射攻破迪恩·亨德森的球门，突显了这位球员的实力，他对埃弗顿的雄心至关重要。“我想比上赛季更好，”迪尤斯伯里-霍尔说道，他在埃弗顿的首个英超赛季中贡献了8个进球和4次助攻。“不仅仅是进球和助攻，还有我的整体表现。几年前我可能没有进球和助攻，但在场上很有影响力。我想把这两者结合起来，当你做到这一点时，你就成了一位全能中场。我知道我有能力做到，所以我祈祷我能做到。”安迪·亨特
比赛报告：埃弗顿2-0水晶宫

利兹联上下充满乐观。首轮客场战胜诺丁汉森林让人们相信丹尼尔·法尔克的球队有能力巩固自己的联赛地位。上赛季保级是目标，但在花费约8000万英镑签下詹姆斯·特拉福德、塔里克·穆哈雷莫维奇和尼科·埃尔维迪，以及免费引入哈里·威尔逊之后，他们希望在联赛第14名的基础上更进一步。利兹联和诺丁汉森林（两队周二将在卡拉宝杯再次相遇）都与切尔西的利亚姆·德拉普传出绯闻；一名能与多米尼克·卡尔弗特-勒温分担进球压力的前锋肯定会提升法尔克的球队。“如果我们想要站稳脚跟，或许几年后谈论别的什么，那么我们就需要增加个人能力，”法尔克说。“上一次这家俱乐部能在顶级联赛连续两个赛季表现出色，你可能在黑白照片里才能找到。”本·费舍尔
比赛报告：诺丁汉森林0-1利兹联

bodyEn: We’re back, baby. Welcome to the content zone. And yes, we did actually go away for a bit. Seriously. Check back. We really did.

In the lead-up to this Premier League opener, Sky Sports had been trailing the fact it will show a total of 1,500 live games this season. Lay these end-to-end and that adds up to about 3,000 hours, or 125 whole days doing nothing but watching football. Chuck in the endless over-gorge of clips, highlights, noises off, VAR rage, furious punditry shemozzles, and that’s pretty much the next eight months spent slumped in your memory foam chair, cramming in those great dripping handfuls of sweet, sweet football-derived product.

For Arsenal’s supporters, on this evidence at least, it might just be a slightly easier experience this time around. They say retaining a title is never easy. Well winning it wasn’t exactly painless either. But how do you manage that altered gravity? On the one hand there’s the Roy Keane approach, performative hunger, serial victory as an act of self-harm. Win the league, stab yourself in the leg, and win it again.

Does hunger matter so much with the game so mechanised, a matter of patterns, systems, processed movements? For Arsenal it is more a case of finding other rhythms and deeper gears. Even before this straightforward 3-0 defeat of Coventry, the goal was clear enough. Win the league, but win it better. Make these games less interesting, or at least less painful.

Well, stage one complete. Two things happened here. First, Arsenal won this game as comfortably as any in the last two seasons. This was like watching a team in demo mode, just trying out the new software, revving the throttle in neutral. And second, Martin Ødegaard played, once again, a little bit more like the half-remembered Martin Ødegaard: 75 minutes, 72 touches, 55 short, clipped little passes. And this is significant.

In the absence of a headline attacking signing, attention has fixed on Ødegaard and the chance he can become himself again after the injury-addled figure of last season. At his best he is just such a constant ferret, a press machine, master of space and of the nudged pass, the look of a thrusting young corporate actuary and the feet of a cage-ball urchin.

Ødegaard’s goal here was the obvious headline moment, Arsenal’s third on 48 minutes. In the moment of execution it felt like a fun and slightly silly thing, the kind of goal Prince Edward might have scored in It’s A Knockout in 1981, set up by Brian Blessed, Emu in goal. But the move to get there was the real deal.

The Norwegian made it in the way he likes to make things, driving the move from just behind the attacking line, twitching the threads. There was a nice delayed pass to Ben White, a drift into space. The finish was comical. Ødegaard sometimes has a strange way of shooting, sidling up to the ball, his foot connecting at an odd angle, a kind of power-stub. Here he miskicked in front of goal, but still sent the ball floating weirdly to the left of Carl Rushworth, who clawed at it helplessly, like a cat flapping its paw at a shadow on the wall.

Ødegaard laughed as he wheeled away. But the celebration was real. This was his first goal at the Emirates since last December. And either side there were signs of something else too, a reawakening of the link-up with Bukayo Saka. Just before half-time they pinged the ball between each other six or seven times, eventually finding space for Declan Rice to shoot just wide. This was like old times. Here they are, the guys, with something between them that is genuinely rare in elite teams: a sense of play, invention, pleasure in the connection.

North London had been agreeably crisp and even a little chilly at kick-off. As a contest, Arsenal-Coventry has Classic Barclays energy: Darren Huckerby running the channels, your TV screen making whooshing noises, Richard Keys with a filthy late-August tan, lemon-yellow blazer sleeves hitched up.

Frank Lampard and Mikel Arteta were up on their feet from the start in identical outfits – black slacks, black knitted mock-turtleneck, white soled black trainers – like the advance party for an executive ninja golf day. And the opening goal on 15 minutes was a high-end three-beat move.

First, Christos Tzolis block-tackled the ball back off Milan van Ewijk by the right touchline, then fed it to Riccardo Calafiori. His pass across the front of the penalty area was pinged hard and low through a narrow arc to Kai Havertz. The finish was luxurious, a first-time left-foot volley so relaxed you half-expected to look down and notice Havertz was playing in a pair of tailored leather parlour slippers.

It was 2-0 soon afterwards, as Coventry found themselves overwhelmed, up against something quicker, slicker and more smoothly geared than many of these players will have ever come up against. This was a good Rice moment, his forward run the catalyst. But it was also an Ødegaard moment, a quick little nudged pass making the space for the shift wide and the killer cross. This is what Ødegaard does best, the pass that makes the pass, the smoothing agent, footballing WD-40.

Equally important, perhaps, Myles Lewis-Skelly was also excellent here, tigerish and always involved, barely misplacing a pass. And yes, he was excellent against the champions of the Championship, but he was also excellent in his last game, against the champions of Europe. Who knows, maybe he’s just a really good midfielder.

items.titleZh: 马丁·厄德高重新扮演阿森纳的润滑剂与传球大师角色 | Barney Ronay
items.summaryZh: 厄德高进球看似滑稽，但表现显示他正从伤病赛季中恢复。
bodyZh: 我们回来了，宝贝。欢迎来到内容区。是的，我们确实离开了一段时间。说真的，回头看看，我们真的走了。
在这轮英超揭幕战之前，天空体育一直在预告本赛季将总共播出1500场直播比赛。把这些比赛首尾相连，加起来大约3000小时，也就是125个整天什么都不干只看足球。再加上无穷无尽的视频片段、精彩集锦、场外噪音、对VAR的愤怒、激烈的解说争吵，那么接下来的八个月基本上就是你瘫在记忆棉座椅上，大口吞咽那些滴着汁水的足球衍生品。
对于阿森纳的支持者来说，至少从目前来看，这一次的体验可能会稍微轻松一些。人们说卫冕冠军从来都不容易。其实夺冠也不是毫无痛苦。但你如何应对那种改变的重力？一方面有罗伊·基恩的方式：表演性的饥饿，将连续胜利视为一种自残行为。赢得联赛，刺伤自己的腿，然后再次获胜。
在比赛如此机械化，讲究阵型、体系和程式化动作的情况下，饥饿感还那么重要吗？对阿森纳而言，更多是寻找其他节奏和更深层档位的问题。甚至在这场3比0轻松击败考文垂之前，目标就已足够清晰：赢得联赛，但赢得更漂亮。让这些比赛更少趣味，至少更少痛苦。
好了，第一阶段完成。这里发生了两件事。首先，阿森纳赢得这场比赛的过程与过去两个赛季任何一场一样轻松。就像在看一支处于演示模式的球队，只是试运行新软件，在空挡上轰油门。其次，马丁·厄德高再次踢得有点像记忆模糊中的那个马丁·厄德高：75分钟，72次触球，55次短传和干脆利落的小范围传球。这意义重大。
在没有重磅攻击线引援的情况下，人们将注意力集中在厄德高身上，以及他在经历了上赛季伤病缠身的表现后能否再次做回自己的机会。在最佳状态下，他就像一只永不停歇的雪貂，一台逼抢机器，空间和轻推传球的大师，有着雄心勃勃的年轻公司精算师的外表和街头笼式足球顽童的双脚。
厄德高本场的进球是明显的头条时刻，这是阿森纳第48分钟的第三球。在进球瞬间，这感觉像是一个有趣又有点愚蠢的动作，有点像1981年爱德华王子在《这是淘汰赛》里可能打进的那种球，由布赖恩·布莱塞德助攻，鸸鹋把守球门。但达到这一进球的配合过程才是真正的实力。
这位挪威人用他喜欢的方式制造了这个进球，从进攻线后方策动进攻，拨动局势。给本·怀特送出一记精妙延迟传球，然后飘移到空当。射门动作则有些滑稽。厄德高有时有一种奇特的射门方式，侧身接近球，脚以奇怪的角度触球，有点像用力一捅。这次他在球门前踢呲了，但仍让球怪异地飘向卡尔·拉什沃思的左侧，后者无助地扑抓，就像一只猫对着墙上的影子挥动爪子。
厄德高转身时笑了，但庆祝是真实的。这是他在酋长球场自去年12月以来的首粒进球。两侧还有其他迹象，那就是与布卡约·萨卡的连线重新被唤醒。就在半场结束前，他们互相传球六七次，最终为德克兰·赖斯创造出空间，后者射门稍稍偏出。这就像昔日时光。他们就在这里，这些人之间有一种在精英球队中真正罕见的东西：乐于玩耍、创造和享受连线。
开球时，北伦敦的天气宜人而清爽，甚至有点冷。阿森纳对考文垂的比赛带有经典英超能量：达伦·哈克比在边路奔跑，电视屏幕发出嗖嗖的声音，理查德·基斯带着8月底晒出的一身黝黑肤色，卷起柠檬黄西装外套的袖子。

弗兰克·兰帕德和米克尔·阿尔特塔从开场就站了起来，穿着相同的服装——黑色长裤、黑色针织假高领毛衣、白底黑运动鞋——就像高管忍者高尔夫日的先遣队。第15分钟的开场进球是一次高端的三拍配合。
首先，克里斯托斯·佐利斯在右路边线铲回米兰·范埃维克的球，然后传给里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里。后者在禁区前沿的传球经一个狭窄弧线大力低平送至凯·哈弗茨。射门动作极为奢华，一脚轻松的左脚本能凌空抽射，让你差点低头去看哈弗茨是不是穿着一双定制的皮制室内拖鞋。
随后不久比分变为2比0，考文垂发现自己被碾压，他们面对的是许多球员从未遭遇过的更快、更流畅、更顺滑的运转。这是赖斯的好时刻，他的前插是催化剂。但这也是厄德高的时刻，一记快速的轻推传球为边路转移和致命传中创造空间。这正是厄德高的拿手好戏：创造传球机会的传球，润滑剂，足球界的WD-40。
同样重要的，或许还有迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利，他同样表现出色，如猛虎般积极，几乎从不传球失误。是的，他对阵英冠冠军发挥出色，但在上一场对阵欧洲冠军的比赛中也同样出色。谁知道呢，也许他就是一个真正出色的中场。

bodyEn: Mikel Arteta has warned there is plenty more to come from Arsenal’s established stars this season after they began their Premier League title defence with a convincing victory over Coventry.

A week after dispatching Manchester City by the same scoreline in last week’s Community Shield, goals from Kai Havertz, Bukayo Saka and Martin Ødegaard sealed a comfortable victory for the champions. Arsenal, who unveiled their new £55m signing Ezri Konsa before kick-off, have now won 18 of their past 19 games against newly promoted teams and never looked like stumbling against Frank Lampard’s side.

But while there has been speculation in Spain that Arsenal could still make a move for Atlético Madrid’s Julián Alvarez before the end of the transfer window, Arteta singled out Saka and Ødegaard’s performances against Coventry and believes they are ready to contribute more after two injury-hit seasons.

“The main focus has to be to improve our players, improve the connection between them because they are already so good,” he said. “When we talk about attacking input, last season we missed some of those players for a lot of months, and the team still had the ability to perform and win a lot of matches and when we have them, then that’s a bonus.”

Asked whether Arsenal could be tempted to make a move for Alvarez in the next week, he said: “I’m really happy with the squad that we have and the main focus is to improve the players that we already have because we already have a lot of good things.”

Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus were both absent from the match day squad as Arsenal attempt to offload the Brazil internationals, with any move for Alvarez likely to rest on them leaving. But Arteta was positive about the prospect of having Bruno Guimarães back from a groin injury soon after the £75m midfielder was ruled out of the opener.

“We don’t expect that to be weeks,” he said. “Let’s see how he evolves this week. He didn’t even want to stop. He wanted to carry on. Now we start to understand the character of the player, but I don’t expect that to be a big issue.”

Coventry struggled in their first Premier League game since 2001 after winning the Championship last year but Lampard said he was proud of his side’s reaction with many of them playing at this level for the first time.

“We lost the game and we will learn our lessons. Every game won’t look like that,” he said. “Leeds came here last year and lost 5-0 and stayed in the Premier League so I’m not making any early judgments. There are adjustments for us to make and we’ll make them.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔预测主力球员“表现会更多”，谈及阿尔瓦雷斯传闻
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔表示对现有阵容满意，认为主力球员还有提升空间。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔警告称，阿森纳在本赛季以一场令人信服的胜利开始英超卫冕之旅后，队中的核心球员还有更多潜力可挖。
在上一周社区盾杯中以相同比分击败曼城后，凯·哈弗茨、布卡约·萨卡和马丁·厄德高的进球为卫冕冠军锁定了这场轻松的胜利。阿森纳在开球前展示了他们5500万英镑的新援埃兹里·孔萨，他们在过去19场对阵升班马的比赛中赢下了18场，面对弗兰克·兰帕德的球队时从未有过失手迹象。
尽管西班牙有传闻称阿森纳可能在转会窗口关闭前对马德里竞技的胡利安·阿尔瓦雷斯采取行动，但阿尔特塔特别提到了萨卡和厄德高对阵考文垂的表现，并相信他们在经历两个伤病困扰的赛季后能够贡献更多。
“主要焦点必须放在提升我们的球员水平，增强他们之间的联系，因为他们已经非常出色了，”他表示。“当我们谈论进攻端贡献时，上赛季我们有数月缺少一些球员，但球队仍然有能力表现出色并赢得许多比赛，当他们回归时，那就是一种额外的收获。”
在被问及阿森纳是否会在接下来一周内尝试引进阿尔瓦雷斯时，他说：“我对我们现有的阵容非常满意，主要焦点是提升我们已有的球员，因为我们已经拥有很多好东西。”
加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯都未进入比赛日大名单，阿森纳试图出售这两位巴西国脚，任何引进阿尔瓦雷斯的行动都可能取决于他们的离队。但阿尔特塔对布鲁诺·吉马良斯即将从腹股沟伤势中复出感到乐观，这位7500万英镑的中场球员缺席了揭幕战。
“我们预计那不会持续数周，”他说。“让我们看看他本周的恢复情况。他甚至不想停下来，他想继续比赛。现在我们开始了解这名球员的性格，但我预计这不是大问题。”
考文垂在去年赢得英冠冠军后，自2001年以来首次参加英超比赛，他们表现挣扎，但兰帕德表示他为球队的反应感到骄傲，其中许多人首次在这个级别比赛。
“我们输掉了比赛，我们会吸取教训。每场比赛不会都像这样，”他说。“去年利兹联来这里0-5输球，但仍然留在英超，所以我不会过早下结论。我们还有调整要做，我们会去做的。”

items.titleEn: Arsenal 3-0 Coventry City: Premier League – as it happened
items.summaryEn: Kai Havertz, Bukayo Saka and Martin Ødegaard were all on target as Arsenal began their title defence in stylePlenty of debutants in the cast tonight. Every single one of them will have been dreaming of something like this …Mikel Arteta’s turn to talk pitchside to Sky. “The players need that desire to go again … I certainly have it … we have to create an opportunity … we don’t know what other clubs are going to do … we have to be the best version of ourselves … we have to deliver our game for 96 minutes every three days … if you are not capable of doing that, you are in trouble … we have to get better … we are trying to improve the team [in the transfer window] … but so far I am very happy.” Continue reading...
bodyEn: … and with that, this MBM comes to an end. Ed Aarons was at the Emirates, and here’s his report. Thanks for reading this one!

Frank Lampard’s turn to talk to Sky. “Clearly a big challenge … fantastic team … a good lesson for our boys … they played like champions … the experience is probably good for us … the goals were not great from us … you’ve seen more from us than that … we’ll improve … I don’t want to judge the lads on that tonight … I’m calm … we lost the game and we will learn our lessons … every game won’t look like that … I’m not concerned about the touches in the box tonight [Coventry had four] … the result is what it is … we’ll go over the detail and get better … we were a little bit timid in the first half … Leeds came here last year and lost 5-0 and stayed in the Premier League so I’m not making any early judgements … there are adjustments for us to make and we’ll make them … it has to be positive even if defeat is hard to take always … there may be more to do while the window is still open … we’re pretty happy with where we are at the minute.”

Mikel Arteta speaks to Sky. “There was a lot to like, right from the beginning … we were really dominant … flow … connected with each other in a really impressive way … overall very positive … a lot of big individual performances as well … I was very impressed … there were moments after the third goal I wasn’t too happy about … the compactness of the team … we need to keep improving … [Bruno Guimarães and Ezri Konsa] are 28, not 38, in their prime … they are going to give us so much.”
Ed Aarons was at the Emirates. Here’s his report … though if you’re after the views of both managers, make sure to come back here, because this MBM is not done just yet.

Coming up … Next for Arsenal: a trip to Aston Villa on Bank Holiday Monday. Coventry will have played twice by then, after going to Plymouth Argyle in the League Cup next Tuesday, and hosting Hull City at home on the Saturday.

Coventry captain Matt Grimes talks to Sky. “Disappointing … we’ve not been used to losing … we always knew it would be a tough ask … we spoke at half-time about being a bit braver … we were a little bit in our shells in the first half … so we wanted to give a better account of ourselves … when you play such a high level of player, little mistakes become big mistakes … we’re ready for it … we want to give the season a good go … our season is not going to be defined by coming to places like this and getting beat … obviously we wanted to cause a bit of an upset but it wasn’t meant to be … we learned a lot … we go again … we won’t be too disheartened.”

Arsenal captain and player of the match Martin Ødegaard talks to Sky Sports. “First game of the season is always a bit nervy … they played well … they gave us a good battle … we created a lot of chances … it was solid … there are things we could have done better … we could be more precise and sharp around the box … many times we play a low block … we need those relationships … a lot of movement … even more sharp with the last pass … the quality in the squad is unbelievable … we push each other … [his goal] was not the best finish but I was there!”

Some numerical admin. The xG finished Arsenal 1.80, Coventry 0.28. Meanwhile … and we do appreciate that some readers might consider this a bit previous … here’s what tonight’s match has done to the top and bottom of the table. Can anyone catch Arsenal? Can Coventry stage a great escape? Yes, we really should know better; thank you so much for putting up with us.

The Emirates breaks into warm applause as Arsenal open their title defence with a fine performance. Martin Ødegaard ran the show, Premier League debutant Christos Tzolis was a constant threat on the left, Bukayo Saka looks back to his best on the right. They’ll take some knocking off their perch. Coventry meanwhile won’t get a tougher assignment all season – they’ve just visited the home of the best team in England and the second-best in Europe – and while the late chance missed by Jack Rudoni will irritate a little bit, if nothing else it proves they’re capable of crafting something against the big teams. And they limited Arsenal to three, when for a while things threatened to get out of hand. Some useful lessons learned. Arsenal’s future is assured; it’s far from the end of the world for the Sky Blues.
The champions open their defence with a confident win.

90 min +3: “A steep learning curve for the Sky Blues,” writes Robert Jones. “I was expecting an absolute humiliation after the first half, but Coventry have learnt a lot about themselves with a worthy performance in the second half.”
90 min +2: Now it’s Coventry fans filling the air with song, as they give Jimmy Hill’s spin on the Eton Boating Song a run out.
90 min +1: In the first of four additional minutes, Havertz aims for the bottom right from long range. Rushworth gets down to stop.

90 min: Torp balloons the free kick over everyone’s head. Goal kick. On Sky, Jamie Carragher names Odegaard as the player of the match. I’d have gone Tzolis myself, but Carra’s got the caps and medals, so fair enough.
89 min: Mosquera cynically skittles Awoniyi out on the left, and is fortunate not to go into the book. But it is a free kick, which Torp prepares to send into the mixer.
88 min: It’s all petering out now. Arsenal fans care not a jot, as they run through their champions songbook.

86 min: … so having said that, nine seconds later, Torp crosses from the left and finds Rudoni in the middle, six yards out. Rudoni has to score, but slaps a header straight at Raya. That should have been the consolation.
85 min: Onyeka sprays a long pass down the left for Awoniyi to chase … but there’s simply no way past Mosquera, who escorts him away from danger. Coventry haven’t threatened a consolation at all.
83 min: Coventry welcome back Hamer, who replaces Tchaouna.
82 min: Califiori is replaced by Hincapie. Arsenal’s squad depth is outrageous.
81 min: Zubimendi whips a cross in dangerously from the right. Havertz prepares to head home from close range, but Amenda flicks clear, just in time. A goal-saving clearance.
80 min: Arsenal pass the ball around with style and sass. Coventry hold their shape.

78 min: Madueke rides a couple of challenges to keep possession down the right, before slipping Merino into space in the box. For once, Merino’s goalscoring radar is off, and his poor shot is easily blocked.

76 min: Merino and Eze come on for Odegaard and Tzolis, who has already earned hero status if the cheer his name receives is anything to go by. Which it is. Deservedly so, given his eye-catching performances so far.
74 min: Van Ewijk throws long from the right. Mosquera heads clear. Rudoni nearly nips in from the left, but can’t reach the ball. Coventry still haven’t put Raya to work.

72 min: Madueke is quickly into the action, swaying down the inside-right before feeding Odegaard infield. Odegaard opens his body and shoots, but his effort is blocked. Arsenal come again, and Lewis-Skelly nearly releases Calafiori into the box with a cute pass down the inside-left channel. Rushworth is out quickly to smother and claim.
70 min: Coventry respond with a double change of their own. Thomas-Asante and the disappointing Simms are replaced by Rudoni and another debutant in Awoniyi.
69 min: Rice and Saka make way for Madueke and Zubimendi. Arsenal in full squad-management mode now.

67 min: Thomas takes a speculative whack from distance. He doesn’t connect properly, the shot dragged harmlessly left, but it looks like the ball takes a nick off Mosquera on its way out of play. Coventry don’t get the corner, and surround the referee, Grimes nearly getting himself booked (or worse) for telling it as he sees it, perhaps even the gentle laying on of hands. The referee stays calm and makes do with a lecture.

65 min: Tzolis continues to tear it up down the left. He reaches the edge of the box and tries to slip in Havertz on the underlap; Thomas comes across to concede another corner. Rice swings it in. Rushworth clears. Tzolis meets the dropping ball and fires through the crowd. Rushworth parries, but can’t claim, and Amenda is forced to hoick clear. It’s not been a banner evening for the Coventry keeper.
63 min: One of Coventry’s debutants, the midfielder Yirenkyi, makes way for Torp.
62 min: Rice plays the corner short, but Coventry intercept and break en masse. But Dasilva can’t decide who to pass to, and the counter fizzles out.
61 min: Tzolis and Calafiori combine down the left, the latter eventually cutting back for the winger, whose first-time screeching shot pings off Grimes and out for another Arsenal corner.
60 min: Simms’ miscontrol was Coventry’s first touch in the Arsenal box this evening. It’s been a baptism of fire all right.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳3-0考文垂：英超比赛实录
items.summaryZh: 哈弗茨、萨卡和厄德高破门，阿森纳卫冕首战告捷。
bodyZh: ……就此，本场博客报道结束。埃德·阿伦斯在酋长球场，以下是他的报道。感谢阅读！

弗兰克·兰帕德接受天空体育采访。“显然是个巨大的挑战……优秀的球队……对我们的球员是很好的一课……他们踢出了冠军风范……这次经历对我们或许有益……那几个丢球我们处理得不好……你们见过我们更好的表现……我们会改进……我不想今晚就评价球员……我很冷静……我们输了比赛，会吸取教训……不是每场比赛都会这样……我不担心禁区内的触球次数（考文垂4次）……结果就是结果……我们会复盘细节并变得更好……上半场我们有点怯场……去年利兹联来这儿0-5输球但保级成功，所以我不会过早下判断……我们需要调整，我们会做出调整……即使失利难以接受，也要保持积极……转会窗口还开着，可能还有动作……目前我们对现状相当满意。”
米克尔·阿尔特塔接受天空体育采访。“从一开始就有很多亮点……我们完全掌控了比赛……行云流水……球员之间呼应得令人印象深刻……整体非常积极……也有很多个人高光表现……我印象深刻……第三个进球后有些时刻我不太满意……球队的紧凑性……我们需要继续进步……（布鲁诺·吉马良斯和埃兹里·孔萨）才28岁，不是38岁，正值巅峰……他们会给我们带来很多。”
埃德·阿伦斯在酋长球场。以下是他的报道……不过如果你想听两位主帅的观点，请一定回到这里，因为本场博客还没结束。
接下来……阿森纳的下一场比赛：节礼日周一客场挑战阿斯顿维拉。考文垂在那之前还要踢两场，下周二联赛杯客场对普利茅斯，周六主场迎战赫尔城。

考文垂队长马特·格莱姆斯接受天空体育采访。“令人失望……我们不习惯输球……我们一直知道这会很艰难……中场休息时我们说要有更多勇气……上半场我们有点缩在壳里……所以我们要拿出更好的表现……当你面对这种级别的球员，小错误就会变成大错误……我们准备好了……我们想好好踢这个赛季……我们的赛季不会因为来这种地方输球而被定义……显然我们想制造冷门，但事与愿违……我们学到很多……我们会继续前进……不会太沮丧。”
阿森纳队长、本场最佳马丁·厄德高接受天空体育采访。“赛季第一场比赛总是有点紧张……他们踢得很好……给了我们一场硬仗……我们创造了很多机会……表现很扎实……有些地方我们本可以做得更好……在禁区附近可以更精准、更犀利……很多时候对方摆大巴……我们需要那些传跑配合……更多跑动……最后一传更锐利……球队阵容深度令人难以置信……我们互相激励……（我的进球）不是最精彩的射门，但我到位了！”
一些数据。预期进球（xG）阿森纳1.80，考文垂0.28。同时……我们也知道一些读者可能觉得这有点早……这是今晚比赛对积分榜两端的影响。有人能追上阿森纳吗？考文垂能上演大逃亡吗？是的，我们真该更有分寸；感谢你们的包容。

酋长球场响起热烈掌声，阿森纳以一场出色表现开启卫冕之旅。马丁·厄德高掌控比赛，英超首秀的克里斯托斯·佐利斯在左路持续制造威胁，布卡约·萨卡在右路恢复最佳状态。他们很难被拉下王座。而考文垂整个赛季也不会遇到更艰难的比赛了——他们刚刚做客英格兰最好、欧洲第二好的球队的主场——虽然杰克·鲁多尼错失的尾声机会有点令人懊恼，但至少证明他们有能力对抗强队制造机会。而且他们只让阿森纳进了三个球，而一度局面有失控的风险。吸取了一些有用的教训。阿森纳的未来无忧；对考文垂而言，这也远非世界末日。
卫冕冠军以一场自信的胜利开启新赛季。
第90+3分钟：“对考文垂来说是一道陡峭的学习曲线，”罗伯特·琼斯写道。“上半场后我本以为会是一场羞辱，但考文垂下半场表现可圈可点，对自己有了很多了解。”
第90+2分钟：现在轮到考文垂球迷歌声嘹亮，他们唱起了吉米·希尔的《伊顿划船歌》变调版。
第90+1分钟：在补时4分钟的第1分钟，哈弗茨远射瞄向右下角。拉什沃思下地扑出。
第90分钟：托普的任意球高射炮越过所有人头顶。球门球。天空体育的杰米·卡拉格将厄德高评为全场最佳。我自己会选佐利斯，但卡拉格有帽子戏法和奖牌，所以这也合理。
第89分钟：莫斯克拉在左路粗野地撞倒阿沃尼伊，幸运的是没有吃牌。但犯规了，托普准备将球送入禁区。
第88分钟：一切正趋于平淡。阿森纳球迷毫不在意，唱着他们的冠军歌单。
第86分钟：……刚说完，9秒后，托普从左路传中，找到禁区中路6码处的鲁多尼。鲁多尼必进机会，却将头球直接顶向拉亚。这本该是个安慰球。
第85分钟：奥涅卡左路长传找阿沃尼伊……但莫斯克拉贴防，将他带离危险区域。考文垂根本没有威胁到安慰球。
第83分钟：考文垂换人，哈默替换查乌纳。
第82分钟：卡拉菲奥里被因卡皮耶换下。阿森纳的阵容深度令人发指。
第81分钟：祖比门迪从右路传中制造险情。哈弗茨近距离准备头球，但阿门达及时解围。一次救命解围。
第80分钟：阿森纳优雅而从容地传导球。考文垂保持阵型。
第78分钟：马杜埃凯右路连续突破两人防守，然后斜塞禁区内的梅里诺。这一次梅里诺的进球嗅觉失灵，糟糕的射门轻易被封堵。
第76分钟：厄德高和佐利斯被换下，换上梅里诺和埃泽。佐利斯已经赢得英雄地位，从听到他名字时的欢呼声就能看出。确实如此。考虑到他目前的表现，实至名归。
第74分钟：范埃韦克右路长距离掷界外球。莫斯克拉头球解围。鲁多尼差点从左路插上，但够不到球。考文垂仍未让拉亚有表现机会。
第72分钟：马杜埃凯迅速投入比赛，内切到右肋，然后将球传给中路的厄德高。厄德高拉开身体射门，但被挡出。阿森纳继续进攻，刘易斯-斯凯利几乎用一记精妙的直塞穿透左肋将卡拉菲奥里送入禁区。拉什沃思迅速出击没收皮球。
第70分钟：考文垂也做出两处调整。托马斯-阿桑特和表现不佳的西姆斯被换下，换上鲁多尼和另一位首秀球员阿沃尼伊。
第69分钟：赖斯和萨卡被换下，换上马杜埃凯和祖比门迪。阿森纳现在全面进入阵容管理模式。
第67分钟：托马斯远距离发力抽射。没踢正部位，球偏出左侧，但看起来球蹭到莫斯克拉出了底线。考文垂没有得到角球，球员围住裁判，格莱姆斯差点因此吃牌（甚至更糟），他直言不讳，或许还有轻微的推搡。裁判保持冷静，只是口头警告。
第65分钟：佐利斯继续在左路肆虐。他带球到禁区边缘，试图塞给内切的哈弗茨；托马斯横移过来再次送出角球。赖斯开角球。拉什沃思击出。佐利斯迎球怒射，穿过人丛。拉什沃思扑出，但未能拿住，阿门达被迫大脚解围。对考文垂门将来说这不是个美妙的夜晚。
第63分钟：考文垂的首秀中场伊伦基被换下，换上托普。
第62分钟：赖斯短角球，但考文垂拦截并集体反击。但达席尔瓦犹豫不决，反击草草收场。
第61分钟：佐利斯和卡拉菲奥里左路配合，后者回敲给边锋，佐利斯迎球爆射，球打在格莱姆斯身上出底线，又是一个角球。
第60分钟：西姆斯停球失误是考文垂今晚首次在阿森纳禁区内触球。真是一场火与血的洗礼。

bodyEn: What a difference a title makes. The last time Arsenal played in front of their own supporters, you could cut the nervous tension with a knife as Mikel Arteta’s side scraped to a 1-0 victory over already relegated Burnley. Ninety five days on and having ended their long wait to be crowned champions the following night when Manchester City slipped up against Bournemouth, Arsenal gave Coventry a rude awakening in their first Premier League game for 25 years.

It’s now 46 matches since Arsenal lost at home to a newly promoted side and there was never any doubt about this result as soon as Kai Havertz – who scored the only goal against Burnley that turned out to be priceless – picked up where he left off by giving Arsenal the lead in the 15th minute. A tap-in from Bukayo Saka and captain Martin Ødegaard matching his Premier League tally from last season just after half-time made it almost the perfect start for the reigning champions.

Arteta had warned beforehand that his players were hungry for more silverware this season and as well as assembling one of the deepest squads, they now have the vital experience of having actually done it. It was telling that with 15 minutes still to play and his side cruising towards victory, the Arsenal manager had the luxury of replacing the outstanding Ødegaard and Declan Rice with two World Cup winners in Mikel Merino and Martín Zubimendi.

It could have been much worse for Coventry had Arsenal not taken their foot off the accelerator by then. But Frank Lampard will know that their chances of survival will not rest on this result and next week’s homecoming against Hull should provide more of a barometer of their prospects.

In another show of their considerable strength, Arsenal had paraded their new signing Ezri Konsa before kick-off after the England defender completed his £51m move from Aston Villa. But they were without Bruno Guimarães after the £75m midfielder picked up an injury on his debut in Sunday’s convincing Community Shield victory over City.

• Mikel Arteta recorded his 150th Premier League victory in charge of Arsenal, and is now one of only five managers to reach 150 wins in fewer than 250 games (249), after Pep Guardiola (204), José Mourinho (231), Jürgen Klopp (237), and Alex Ferguson (247).

• Arsenal are unbeaten in 46 Premier League home games against promoted sides, extending the longest such run by any team in the competition’s history (W41 D5). Within this run, they have won the most recent 17 matches by an aggregate score of 47-9.
• Frank Lampard (pictured) has won only one of his last 18 games as a manager in the Premier League (D4 L13), while his side have failed to keep a clean sheet in each of the last 17. Opta

Coventry’s line-up contained five new signings including the Ghana midfielder Caleb Yirenkyi and it showed. At least they managed to avoid a repeat of their only two previous visits to this stadium when they conceded 10 goals in FA and League Cup ties at a time they were in the third tier. But while not many of the supporters who made the journey to north London will remember Micky Quinn’s hat-trick in Coventry’s win on the opening day of the 1993-94 season at the old Highbury, Lampard had urged his players to show belief that they belong at this level.

Sadly for him, Arsenal were in no mood for sentimentality. Christos Tzolis was not the most eye-catching arrival of the summer but the Greece forward was a lively presence from the start and could have given them the lead twice in the first 10 minutes before Havertz eventually did. Tzolis and Riccardo Calafiori teamed up on the left flank to dispossess Milan van Ewijk and the Italian rolled a pass perfectly on to the onrushing Havertz to finish.

Before Coventry knew what had hit them they were two behind. A flowing move started by Rice involving a clever one-two with Ødegaard saw Carl Rushworth play a cross from Tzolis straight to the grateful Saka. Yirenkyi went into the book for hauling down Myles Lewis-Skelly as Coventry struggled to keep their heads above water. It was no surprise that Lampard looked so concerned as he watched on with his arms folded firmly across his chest. Only four of his squad have previous Premier League experience that amounts to little more than 200 games in total. They will need to learn quickly.

Loum Tchaouna almost caught David Raya napping with a speculative lob just before half-time but Yirenkyi was perhaps fortunate not to be shown a second yellow card after catching Tzolis with a late challenge.

Coventry’s luck didn’t last long. A scuffed finish from Ødegaard after he was set up by Ben White only four minutes after the restart extinguished any hopes of mounting a comeback. Rushworth’s face said it all as the ball trickled over the line.

From then on it was damage limitation. Rushworth was at full stretch to tip over a powerful drive from Lewis-Skelly before Ødegaard had a goalbound effort deflected wide. But the departures of Rice and Saka with little more than 20 minutes to play was an indication that Arteta was more than satisfied with the scoreline. The substitute Jack Rudoni came closest to grabbing a consolation for the visitors in the dying minutes but Coventry can console themselves with the realisation that it doesn’t get any harder than this.

items.titleZh: 阿森纳横扫考文垂，英超卫冕开门红
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳横扫考文垂，英超卫冕首战取得开门红。
bodyZh: 冠军带来的变化真大。上一次阿森纳在自家球迷面前比赛时，紧张气氛几乎令人窒息——米克尔·阿尔特塔的球队艰难地以1-0击败已降级的伯恩利。95天后，当曼城意外输给伯恩茅斯，阿森纳终结了漫长的等待，夺得冠军。如今，在他们25年来的首场英超比赛中，考文垂被当头棒喝。
阿森纳已经46场没有在主场输给过升班马了。当凯·哈弗茨——正是他在对阵伯恩利时打进了价值连城的唯一进球——在第15分钟为阿森纳取得领先，继续他上赛季的出色状态时，比赛结果便毫无悬念。布卡约·萨卡的轻松补射和队长马丁·厄德高在下半场刚开场便打入一球，追平了他上赛季的英超进球总数，这几乎让卫冕冠军有了完美的开局。
阿尔特塔此前曾警告说，他的球员本赛季渴望更多的奖杯，而且除了打造了一支深度深厚的阵容外，他们如今还拥有了真正夺冠的关键经验。值得注意的是，在比赛还剩15分钟、球队轻松迈向胜利时，阿森纳主帅可以用米克尔·梅里诺和马丁·祖比门迪这两位世界杯冠军成员换下表现出色的厄德高和德克兰·赖斯。
如果阿森纳当时没有放松油门，考文垂的处境会更糟。但弗兰克·兰帕德明白，他们的保级希望不会寄托在这场比赛中，下周对阵赫尔城的回归主场之战将更好地检验他们的前景。
阿森纳还展示了强大的实力，开球前他们展示了新援埃兹里·孔萨，这位英格兰后卫以5100万英镑从阿斯顿维拉转会而来。但他们缺少布鲁诺·吉马良斯，这位7500万英镑的中场在周日社区盾大胜曼城的比赛首秀中受伤。
• 米克尔·阿尔特塔执教阿森纳取得英超第150场胜利，成为仅有的五位在不到250场（249场）联赛中达成150胜的主教练之一。前四位是佩普·瓜迪奥拉（204场）、何塞·穆里尼奥（231场）、尤尔根·克洛普（237场）和亚历克斯·弗格森（247场）。
• 阿森纳在英超主场对阵升班马的比赛中已经46场不败，延续了英超历史上任何球队最长的不败纪录（41胜5平）。在此期间，他们最近17场全部获胜，总比分为47-9。
• 弗兰克·兰帕德（如图）在英超执教的最近18场比赛中仅取得1胜（4平13负），而他的球队在最近17场比赛中均未能保持球门不失。Opta
考文垂的首发阵容中有五名新援，包括加纳中场凯莱布·伊伦基（Caleb Yirenkyi），这一点显而易见。至少他们避免了重蹈此前两次造访该球场的覆辙——当时他们身处第三级别联赛，在足总杯和联赛杯中共丢10球。不过，虽然前往北伦敦的球迷中，没有多少人记得米基·奎因在1993-94赛季揭幕战考文垂客场挑战老海布里时的帽子戏法，但兰帕德已敦促球员们展现出自己属于这个级别的信念。
不幸的是，阿森纳并不想讲情面。克里斯托斯·佐利斯并不是今夏最引人注目的引援，但这位希腊前锋从开场起就十分活跃，本可在前10分钟内两度帮助球队取得领先，直到哈弗茨最终破门。佐利斯与里卡多·卡拉菲奥里在左路联手，从米兰·范埃韦克脚下断球，随后卡拉菲奥里将球完美地滚给插上的哈弗茨，后者完成射门。
考文垂还没搞清楚状况便已落后两球。赖斯发动的一次流畅进攻，与厄德高打出精妙二过一，考文垂门将卡尔·拉什沃思将佐利斯的传中直接送到萨卡脚下，萨卡笑纳大礼。伊伦基因拉倒迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利吃到黄牌，考文垂苦苦支撑。兰帕德双臂抱胸，神情凝重，这并不意外。他的球队中只有四名球员有英超经验，总共也就200多场。他们需要快速学习。
订阅《足球每日》
以《卫报》对足球世界的见解开启你的夜晚
新闻简报推广之后
卢姆·查乌纳在半场结束前的一记吊射差点让大卫·拉亚措手不及，但伊伦基也许很走运，他在对佐利斯的一次铲球后没有吃到第二张黄牌。
考文垂的运气没有持续太久。下半场开场仅4分钟，厄德高接到本·怀特的传球后打出一记踢呲的射门，粉碎了考文垂反扑的希望。皮球滚过门线时，拉什沃思的表情说明了一切。
此后，考文垂只剩下尽力挽回面子。拉什沃思飞身扑出刘易斯-斯凯利的劲射，厄德高随后的一次射门也被挡出。但比赛还剩20多分钟时，赖斯和萨卡都被换下，这表明阿尔特塔对结果十分满意。替补登场的杰克·鲁多尼在最后时刻差点为客队扳回一球，但考文垂可以安慰自己，不会再遇到比这更艰难的比赛了。

items.titleEn: Premier League: 10 things to look out for as the new season kicks off
items.summaryEn: Manchester United’s new-look midfield, Ipswich’s ambition is tested and Kevin Keegan tributes at NewcastleWhile Myles Lewis-Skelly looks likely to remain at the Emirates, the same can’t be said for Ethan Nwaneri. The 19-year-old was outstanding in his breakthrough season for Arsenal in 2024-25 but barely featured last season and was sent on loan to Marseille. That didn’t really work out and Arsenal are now exploring another temporary move to ensure Nwaneri gets regular football this season. Milan, RB Leipzig, Dortmund and Fulham are all thought to be interested, with Nwaneri unlikely to feature on the bench for Friday’s opener against Coventry as a result. Whether Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus are available remains to be seen as Arsenal attempt to find suitors for the Brazil duo. bodyEn: While Myles Lewis-Skelly looks likely to remain at the Emirates, the same can’t be said for Ethan Nwaneri. The 19-year-old was outstanding in his breakthrough season for Arsenal in 2024-25 but barely featured last season and was sent on loan to Marseille. That didn’t really work out and Arsenal are now exploring another temporary move to ensure Nwaneri gets regular football this season. Milan, RB Leipzig, Dortmund and Fulham are all thought to be interested, with Nwaneri unlikely to feature on the bench for Friday’s opener against Coventry as a result. Whether Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel Jesus are available remains to be seen as Arsenal attempt to find suitors for the Brazil duo. Ed Aarons
Arsenal v Coventry City, Friday 8pm (all times BST)

Manchester United’s summer transfer business has focused on recruiting in central midfield. It will be interesting to see who Michael Carrick selects in two key roles for the first game of the season. Andrey Santos and Youri Tielemans have been present for more of pre-season than Kobbie Mainoo, who did not play a minute for England at the World Cup and was a late returner to Carrington after a holiday. Carlos Baleba surely will not have arrived in time to start at Hull. Mainoo is in the best position in the long term but if Carrick decides to ease him into the season, it would be intriguing to see how Santos and Tielemans team up, the stress test for a new partnership that could provide the perfect balance of defensive awareness and ability to move the team up the pitch. Will Unwin
Hull City v Manchester United, Saturday 12.30pm

Neither Everton nor Crystal Palace have enjoyed a particularly scintillating summer of transfer activity but combined to make headlines with a swap deal between Dwight McNeil and Brennan Johnson. The pair will face one another – and their former clubs - on the first weekend of the season, eager to prove what their worth to their new teams. McNeil was rarely a regular on Merseyside but had a positive second half to last season, ironically after a move to Crystal Palace fell through at the last minute. Johnson did not settle at Selhurst Park, unable to crack the code that would get him into the starting lineup on a weekly basis, after moving from Spurs. A fresh start should reinvigorate the duo and there is no better way to further boost the mood than beating a former employer. WU
Everton v Crystal Palace, Saturday 3pm

Ipswich clearly learned a lot from what Sunderland did a year ago, as they went out and bought a lot of players. The Black Cats quickly moulded their 19 acquisitions into a successful unit but at least they had the positive of a head coach in Régis Le Bris who had his feet under the table. Gary O’Neil is the new man at Portman Road and he has 12 signings – at time of writing – to potentially use for the opener. The record arrival, Emersonn, who has moved to Portman Road from Toulouse, is the most eye-catching of those who have been acquired. The Brazilian has an underwhelming career goalscoring record and a few question marks hanging over his head. Even though it is their first game, Ipswich need to pick up points at home, and to do so require a striker who can cause problems for defenders. How quickly Emersonn adapts will be critical for the Tractor Boys’ success this year. WU
Ipswich Town v Sunderland, Saturday 3pm

August is the season for debuts and no one will be more satisfied than Oliver Glasner when Ousmane Diomande steps over the white line at the City Ground. Glasner wanted the Ivorian centre-back to replace Marc Guéhi at Crystal Palace, six months before the England defender departed for Manchester City. Diomande, a £34m buy from Sporting, is expected to line up in a back three for Nottingham Forest against Leeds, when the Austria midfielder Xaver Schlager, who played for Glasner at Wolfsburg, could also make his Forest bow. Diomande is a quick and physical defender but another aspect of his appeal is his aerial power at set pieces. “They’ve both played Champions League football and they are used to competing for titles,” said Glasner. “They can add this winning mentality.” Ben Fisher
Nottingham Forest v Leeds, Saturday 3pm

Cristian Romero has taken his maverick brand of defending to Atlético Madrid, upsetting neutral Premier League watchers. His compatriot Marcos Senesi has arrived to shore up things at the back as Roberto De Zerbi desperately tries to steer Spurs away from a third straight season of battling relegation. The all-action Romero had his qualities as a leader and defender but never felt dependable, which is what most want from a centre-back and captain. Senesi impressed during his time at Bournemouth, rarely making headlines but proving himself a calm presence at the back. The Argentinian is good on the ball and will be more adventurous in possession than his countryman. He is yet to be sent off in three seasons as a Premier League player – Romero was dismissed twice in 2025-26 alone, not to mention a one-match ban and a fine for his behaviour towards a referee. His calmness will improve Spurs. WU
Brentford v Tottenham, Saturday 5.30pm

It is surely not how Unai Emery envisaged the countdown to Aston Villa’s season-opener at Brighton on Sunday – and certainly not as he enjoyed the afterglow from the club’s Europa League triumph over Freiburg in May. The manager has an extraordinary number of problems. Take the midfield where the new signings João Gomes and Johan Manzambi are injury doubts. Note: Amadou Onana is a long-term casualty while Youri Tielemans has been sold. It goes on. Emery is about to lose Ezri Konsa to Arsenal – in a summer where Villa have also sold Morgan Rogers and Lucas Digne. They are trying to move on Emi Martínez, while the future of Ollie Watkins is uncertain, with Al-Hilal circling. For the cherry on top, the rampaging 17-year-old striker Brian Madjo is a fitness concern. Emery’s teamsheet will be very interesting. Will he pitch the new goalkeeper, Zion Suzuki, who only signed on Wednesday, straight in? David Hytner
Brighton v Aston Villa, Sunday 2pm

Is Enzo Maresca already under pressure after Manchester City’s 3-0 schooling by Arsenal in the Community Shield? Maybe not, but if the Italian’s new team go down at home to Bournemouth on Sunday, you do not have to be a soothsayer to picture the scrutiny that will follow. Maresca and City are enduring a difficult transfer window, with Rodri’s departure to Barcelona the headline, a dizzying blow that has to be shaken off. The new Bournemouth coach, Marco Rose, has faced City six times in the Champions League with Leipzig and Mönchengladbach, and is sure to order his visitors to go for the jugular at the Etihad. City are vulnerable but Maresca can remedy this with a win of any sort. This, after all, is the job many felt he was the obvious choice for. Jamie Jackson
Manchester City v Bournemouth, Sunday 2pm

Kevin Keegan was supposed to have been the guest of honour at St James’ Park on Sunday, but his death from cancer in July means this meeting of two of his old clubs will turn into a tribute to one of English football’s enduring heroes. Keegan’s family will be present to witness an outpouring of love for the former Liverpool and Newcastle forward and (twice) Magpies manager. Once the game kicks off, all eyes will be on Alexander Isak, a St James’ Park old boy whose decision to force a £125m move to Anfield last summer did not go down well on Tyneside. The Sweden striker, making his first return to Newcastle, has much to prove at Liverpool, and now has a new head coach to impress in Andoni Iraola. Newcastle too have a new face in the home dugout, where Matthias Jaissle will occupy the technical area for so long inhabited by Eddie Howe. Louise Taylor
Newcastle v Liverpool, Sunday 4.30pm

Real Madrid’s two head coaches from last season meet at Craven Cottage, with the focus on Xabi Alonso, rather than Álvaro Arbeloa. The Fulham man, however, may have more to prove in the Premier League. His managerial career has been less prominent than that of his Basque rival – and he has clearly insisted on snapping up talent from the Bernabéu. Gonzalo García and César Palacios have made the trip over from the Spanish capital with Arbeloa. It shows great faith from the former Liverpool defender but it does put extra pressure on the trio, their fates now permanently intertwined. All three need a positive start to show they merit being in the Premier League. Otherwise, it would be very easily to criticise them individually and collectively. WU
Fulham v Chelsea, Monday 8pm

bodyZh: 尽管迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利看来很可能留在酋长球场，但伊桑·恩瓦内里情况不同。这位19岁球员在2024-25赛季为阿森纳取得突破，表现出色，但上赛季几乎未获出场机会，并被租借至马赛。那次租借并不成功，阿森纳现在正在探索另一次临时转会，以确保恩瓦内里本赛季能获得稳定出场时间。据信米兰、莱比锡红牛、多特蒙德和富勒姆都有意，因此恩瓦内里可能不会出现在周五对阵考文垂的揭幕战替补席上。加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔·热苏斯是否留队仍有待观察，因为阿森纳正为这对巴西组合寻找买家。——埃德·阿伦斯
阿森纳对阵考文垂城，周五晚8点（均为英国夏令时）

曼联的夏季转会操作重点集中在中场引援上。值得关注的是，迈克尔·卡里克将在新赛季首战中如何选择两个关键位置的人选。安德烈·桑托斯和尤里·蒂勒曼斯参加了更多季前赛，而科比·梅努在世界杯上未代表英格兰出场一分钟，度假后也较晚才回到卡灵顿。卡洛斯·巴莱巴肯定无法及时赶到赫尔城首发。长期来看，梅努处于最佳位置，但如果卡里克决定让他慢慢适应赛季，那么桑托斯和蒂勒曼斯如何搭档将很有意思，这是对新组合的考验，他们可能提供防守意识和推进球队能力的完美平衡。——威尔·昂温
赫尔城对阵曼联，周六12点30分

埃弗顿和水晶宫在这个夏天的转会操作都不算特别精彩，但一笔涉及德怀特·麦克尼尔和布伦南·约翰逊的互换交易却让他们一起登上了头条。两人将在新赛季首周对阵彼此——以及他们的前东家，急于向新东家证明自己的价值。麦克尼尔在默西塞德很少成为常规主力，但上赛季后半段表现积极，讽刺的是，此前他转会水晶宫的计划在最后时刻告吹。约翰逊从热刺转会后，在塞尔赫斯特公园未能站稳脚跟，始终无法破解每周进入首发的难题。新的开始应该能让这对组合重振旗鼓，而没有什么比击败前东家更能提升士气了。——威尔·昂温
埃弗顿对阵水晶宫，周六下午3点

伊普斯维奇显然从桑德兰一年前的做法中汲取了教训，他们买进了大量球员。黑猫队迅速将19名新援整合成一个成功的整体，但他们至少拥有一个优势，那就是主教练雷吉斯·勒布里斯已经站稳了脚跟。加里·奥尼尔是波特曼路球场的新任主帅，截至发稿时，他有12名签约球员可供首战使用。创纪录的新援埃默松从图卢兹转会而来，是最引人注目的引援。这位巴西球员职业生涯进球记录并不出色，头顶上也悬着几个问号。尽管这是他们的首场比赛，伊普斯维奇也需要在主场拿分，而要做到这一点，他们需要一名能给对方后卫制造麻烦的前锋。埃默松适应的速度将对“拖拉机男孩”本赛季的成功至关重要。——威尔·昂温
伊普斯维奇对阵桑德兰，周六下午3点

八月是新援首秀的季节，当奥斯曼·迪奥曼德踏入城市球场的白线时，没有人会比奥利弗·格拉斯纳更满意。格拉斯纳曾希望这位科特迪瓦中卫在水晶宫接替马克·格伊，而六个月后，这位英格兰后卫便转会去了曼城。迪奥曼德以3400万英镑从葡萄牙体育签下，预计将在诺丁汉森林对阵利兹联的比赛中出任三中卫之一，而曾在沃尔夫斯堡为格拉斯纳效力的奥地利中场克萨韦尔·施拉格也可能迎来森林首秀。迪奥曼德是一位速度与身体素质兼备的后卫，但另一个吸引人的方面是他在定位球中的空中优势。“他们都踢过欧冠，习惯了争夺冠军，”格拉斯纳说。“他们能带来这种赢家心态。”——本·费舍尔
诺丁汉森林对阵利兹联，周六下午3点

克里斯蒂安·罗梅罗将他的特立独行防守风格带到了马德里竞技，这让中立的英超球迷感到不满。他的同胞马科斯·塞内西已经加盟，以巩固后防，与此同时，罗伯托·德泽尔比拼命试图让热刺避免连续第三个赛季为保级而战。全能型的罗梅罗具备领袖和后卫的品质，但从未让人感到可靠，而这是大多数人对中卫和队长的期望。塞内西在伯恩茅斯效力期间给人留下深刻印象，虽然很少上头条，但证明了自己在后防线上的冷静存在。这位阿根廷球员脚下技术出色，持球时比他的同胞更具冒险精神。他在三个英超赛季中从未被红牌罚下——而罗梅罗仅2025-26赛季就被罚下两次，更不用说他因对裁判的行为而遭到禁赛一场和罚款。他的冷静将提升热刺的表现。——威尔·昂温
布伦特福德对阵热刺，周六下午5点30分

这肯定不是乌奈·埃梅里对周日阿斯顿维拉客场挑战布莱顿的赛季揭幕战所设想的倒计时方式——尤其是在五月俱乐部欧联杯战胜弗赖堡后还沉浸在喜悦中的他。这位主帅面临着大量问题。以中场为例，新援若昂·戈麦斯和约翰·曼赞比有伤疑。注意：阿马杜·奥纳纳长期缺阵，而尤里·蒂勒曼斯已被出售。这还没完。埃梅里即将失去将转会阿森纳的埃兹里·孔萨——在这个夏天，维拉已经出售了摩根·罗杰斯和卢卡斯·迪涅。他们还在试图送走埃米·马丁内斯，而奥利·沃特金斯的未来也不确定，利雅得新月虎视眈眈。更糟糕的是，生猛的17岁前锋布莱恩·马乔也存在健康问题。埃梅里的出场名单将非常有趣。他会让周三才签约的新门将锡安·铃木直接首发吗？——大卫·海特纳
布莱顿对阵阿斯顿维拉，周日下午2点

在曼城社区盾杯被阿森纳3-0教训后，恩佐·马雷斯卡是否已经承受压力？也许没有，但如果这位意大利人的新球队周日在主场输给伯恩茅斯，你无需预言家也能想象随之而来的审视。马雷斯卡和曼城正在经历一个艰难的转会窗口，罗德里转会巴塞罗那成为头条新闻，这是一个令人眩晕的打击，必须尽快摆脱。伯恩茅斯新帅马尔科·罗泽在执教莱比锡和门兴时曾在欧冠六次面对曼城，他肯定会命令客队在伊蒂哈德球场直击要害。曼城很脆弱，但马雷斯卡可以用一场胜利来补救。毕竟，这是他许多人认为理所当然的工作。——杰米·杰克逊
曼城对阵伯恩茅斯，周日下午2点

凯文·基冈本应周日作为圣詹姆斯公园的荣誉嘉宾出席，但他于七月因癌症去世，这意味着这场比赛，他两支老东家的交锋，将变成对这位英格兰足球永恒英雄之一的致敬。基冈的家人将到场，见证人们对这位前利物浦和纽卡斯尔前锋、两度执教喜鹊的主帅表达的热爱。比赛开始后，所有目光都将聚焦亚历山大·伊萨克，这位圣詹姆斯公园旧将去年夏天强行以1.25亿英镑转会安菲尔德，这一举动在泰恩赛德并不受欢迎。这位瑞典前锋首次重返纽卡斯尔，他需要在利物浦证明很多，现在还要给新任主帅安东尼·伊劳拉留下好印象。纽卡斯尔在主场教练席上也有新面孔，马蒂亚斯·耶斯勒将占据埃迪·豪长期占据的技术区域。——路易丝·泰勒
纽卡斯尔对阵利物浦，周日下午4点30分

皇家马德里上赛季的两位主教练在克拉文农场相遇，焦点集中在哈维·阿隆索身上，而不是阿尔瓦罗·阿韦洛亚。然而，富勒姆人阿韦洛亚在英超可能更需要证明自己。他的执教生涯不如他的巴斯克对手那样突出——而且他显然坚持从伯纳乌引进人才。贡萨洛·加西亚和塞萨尔·帕拉西奥斯随阿韦洛亚一同从西班牙首都来到伦敦。这体现了这位前利物浦后卫的极大信任，但也给三人带来了额外压力，他们的命运现在永久地交织在一起。三人都需要积极的开局来证明他们配得上英超。否则，很容易对他们个人和集体进行批评。——威尔·昂温
富勒姆对阵切尔西，周一晚8点
