bodyEn: Mikel Arteta wants to get his messaging absolutely right. According to him, Arsenal are not about to defend their Premier League title. They are set to attack another one.

Remember Win the dog, who the manager brought in to the club’s training ground a few years back? She must now be called “Won”. But it is when Arteta quibbles over another bout of semantics that he highlights why he is entering the new season with such energy and optimism.

Do not talk to him about Arsenal’s stability. He prefers the word “consistency” along with more thrusting ones like “ambition”. The overall theme is clear. When Arteta surveys the landscape at the top end of the English game, he sees a settled environment at his club and flux elsewhere.

In terms of the so-called Big Six – the richest clubs in the country, as ranked by Deloitte – there are new managers at Manchester City, Liverpool and Chelsea; a virtually new one at Tottenham and a relatively new one at Manchester United. It has been a summer of unprecedented change in the Premier League with nine clubs with a new man in charge. Of those who hold out hope of a title challenge, only Aston Villa have a fully bedded-in manager in Unai Emery.

Rather abruptly, Arteta finds himself as the longest-serving manager in the division; he took over from Emery at Arsenal in December 2019. Emery is second on the list, having been at Villa for three years and nine months, and only one other – Daniel Farke at Leeds – has been at his club for more than three years.

When Arteta was given the job at Arsenal, Pep Guardiola was two titles into his storied City tenure, Jürgen Klopp had won the Champions League at Liverpool and was on his way to winning the league that season and José Mourinho had just joined Spurs.
Arteta has seen them all off, with Guardiola’s departure from City at the end of last season being the most significant single shift in the dynamics for the forthcoming campaign.

Arteta is now the big beast, the only current manager to have won the Premier League, and as Arsenal prepare for the curtain-raiser at home to Coventry on Friday night, it is hard to ignore the confidence they are projecting. With virtually of all their rivals in transition, uncertainty undercutting the excitement, predictions difficult to make in the face of little actual evidence, Arsenal are reassured by their firm foundations. They sense opportunity, another title; the creation of a dynasty. That is the ultimate goal.

There is something more. Namely how everything changed for them in the closing weeks of last season. City had done the hard work, clawing back a nine-point deficit from the middle of March – a period when they had a game in hand. But in the five-match shootout that followed, City blinked first, drawing at Everton. Most know how nerve-racking it was for Arsenal. Not least Arteta. The Emirates Stadium was a sea of anxiety when Arsenal last played there – against Burnley in the penultimate game of the season. They got a 1-0 win over the line.

Then City drew at Bournemouth and it was over; Arsenal’s 22-year wait, the oppressive weight. It is impossible to overestimate the feeling of liberation. Nobody can question the bottle of this team. Nobody will taunt them with the cry of “second again, olé, olé.” It is plain Arteta and his players will feed off it and perhaps it will lead to a more expansive style of football. The fear of falling short inhibited their game as the heat rose last time out.

Arsenal have made changes behind the scenes, looking for the marginal gains, most notably in the medical department where the head doctor, Zafar Iqbal, was mutually consented in early June. Arnaldo Abrantes has come in from Aston Villa to replace him. If the players can stay fitter for longer, Arsenal believe they can stay ahead. They have protected themselves with moves to deepen an already well-stocked squad. Bruno Guimarães is the most eye-catching addition, with Ezri Konsa about to follow.

Arsenal versus City still feels like the primary head-to-head. Guardiola had Arteta’s number last season, winning two and drawing one of the three meetings between the clubs. City were much the better team in the Carabao Cup final that they won 2-0. But that was under Guardiola and that was with Rodri and Bernardo Silva. If Guardiola’s exit has hit City the hardest, then those of the commanding midfielders to Barcelona and Real Madrid, respectively, is not far behind.

City’s faith in their new manager, Enzo Maresca, is rooted in what they saw of him when he worked on their coaching staff; he was an assistant to Guardiola in the treble-winning season of 2022-23. Previously, he coached the Under‑23s to the Premier League 2 title in 2020-21.

It is a well-thought-through appointment; the kind a well-run club makes. Yet at the same time, it is not one to quicken the pulse. Maresca, quite simply, has enormous shoes to fill. Ditto Elliot Anderson, the impressive young midfielder upon whom City have bet the house. Can City be better given the personnel losses they have sustained? They must surely do so given the direction of travel at Arsenal. City do retain the cheat code that is Erling Haaland.

There are parallels between City and Liverpool, who want their new manager, Andoni Iraola, to have a similar impact in his first season that Arne Slot managed in 2024-25. Slot took Klopp’s team and glided to the title. Maybe consistency in the dugout is not everything?

On the other hand, Slot was given only one new player – Federico Chiesa – who barely played that season and he essentially stuck with what had made the Klopp collective so successful. It was evolution not revolution. When he tried the latter last season, Slot found that his tenure unravelled, although his rotten luck with injuries must be acknowledged. There was also the death of Diogo Jota.

Liverpool have moved on Andy Robertson, Ibrahima Konaté and, most crucially, Mohamed Salah, even if he was a shadow of his former self last season. Salah has not yet been replaced; it would be impossible to replace the prime-years version of him and Iraola, who has a number of injury concerns, has it all to do.

Coaxing more from Florian Wirtz and Alexander Isak is fundamental. Iraola’s style has the capacity to hold Anfield in thrall; the aggression, the front-foot slickness, the boldness to go one-versus-one all over the pitch. How quickly can he impose it?

Chelsea will be interesting under Xabi Alonso, who has been allowed to add players to fit into the 3-4-2-1 he used to such stunning effect at Bayer Leverkusen. Alonso has also been permitted to break from the club’s youth-first signing model and bring in much-needed experience.

Morgan Rogers, alongside Cole Palmer and behind João Pedro, with Moisés Caicedo and maybe Reece James in the deep midfield roles, has a very nice feel to it. There is talent in central defence. The lack of European football will be a temporary blessing.

Ask any chief executive what supporters want at the start of a season and the answer is invariably the same: be better than last season. Which will not be a problem for Chelsea after the implosion to limp home in 10th. Or Spurs, who finished 17th for the second campaign in a row and narrowly avoided relegation. Roberto De Zerbi, who was appointed as the manager with seven games to go, kept them up and in the first summer since the end of Daniel Levy’s near 25-year as chair, the new hierarchy have been determined to act decisively. Their heavy spend on Premier League-proven players has allowed the fanbase to dream.

De Zerbi is a man to generate buy-in. In him they trust. Ditto a midfield that will feature Sandro Tonali and Mateus Fernandes. With Conor Gallagher or James Maddison expected to fill the No 10 role, Spurs look to have a proper unit to hold things together. They will also benefit from no European football.

What about United, for whom everything suddenly came together after the appointment of Michael Carrick in January, initially for an interim spell? His record meant the club had to give him the job on a permanent basis – he finished the season with 12 wins and three draws from 17 league matches. It was 2.3 points per game. Transpose that over a 38-match campaign and you get 87 points. Arsenal won the title with 85. Are United dark horses for glory?

Concerns remain. Carrick was largely untroubled by injuries and when United have their best XI on the field they are a match for anybody. When they miss a few, as they normally did under Ruben Amorim, they can flatline. United were always going to have to add a good number of signings this summer, particularly as they prepare to go from a Europe-free season to a return to the Champions League. They have not yet done enough; the final week-and-a-half of the transfer window could be crucial. As Mike Tyson almost said, everybody has a plan until they are punched in the face by the Champions League.

Are Villa really about to take another step forward after the highs of last season when they finished fourth and won the Europa League? It feels unlikely given the departures, headlined by those of Rogers, Youri Tielemans and Lucas Digne, with Konsa primed to go, too. Strangely, there is a whiff of transition about them. It is possible to find reasons to fret about every team. Apart from Arsenal.
items.author: David Hytner
items.titleZh: 英超回归，阿森纳在对手动荡之际嗅到机会
items.summaryZh: 众多新帅上任，争冠格局或生变，阿森纳自身渴望成关键。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔想把话说得恰到好处。在他看来，阿森纳并非要卫冕英超冠军，而是要再次发起冲击。
还记得几年前他带到训练场的那只名叫“胜利”的狗吗？现在该叫她“已胜”了。但正是阿尔特塔在咬文嚼字时，凸显了他为何以如此充沛的精力和乐观迎接新赛季。
别和他谈阿森纳的稳定性。他更喜欢“持续性”这个字眼，以及更有冲击力的词，比如“雄心”。总体主题很明确。当阿尔特塔审视英格兰足球顶端格局时，他看到自家俱乐部环境安定，而其他地方一片动荡。
就所谓的“六大豪门”而言——按德勤排名，它们是英格兰最富有的俱乐部——曼城、利物浦和切尔西都换了新帅；热刺几乎算新帅，曼联的教练也相对较新。这是英超前所未有的变革之夏，共有九家俱乐部迎来新掌门人。在那些有望争夺冠军的球队中，只有阿斯顿维拉的主帅埃梅里是彻底站稳脚跟的。
颇为突然地，阿尔特塔发现自己成了联赛中执教时间最长的主帅；他于2019年12月在阿森纳接替埃梅里。埃梅里在维拉已执教三年九个月，名列第二，除此之外只有利兹联的法尔克执教超过三年。
当阿尔特塔接手阿森纳时，瓜迪奥拉已带领曼城夺得两个冠军，克洛普在利物浦赢得欧冠并有望当季捧起联赛奖杯，穆里尼奥刚刚加盟热刺。
阿尔特塔送走了他们所有人，其中瓜迪奥拉在季末离开曼城，是对即将到来的赛季格局最重大的单一改变。
阿尔特塔如今是巨头，是唯一一位赢得过英超冠军的现任主帅。当阿森纳准备周五晚在主场迎战考文垂的揭幕战时，很难忽视他们流露出的自信。几乎所有对手都在过渡期，不确定性消解了兴奋感，面对几乎没有实际证据的预测难以作出，阿森纳则因稳固的根基而安心。他们嗅到了机会——又一个冠军；一个王朝的建立。那才是终极目标。
还有更多。即上赛季最后几周他们经历的一切。曼城做了艰苦卓绝的工作，从三月中旬起追回九分差距——那段时期他们还有一场补赛。但在随后的五场决战中，曼城先眨了眼，战平埃弗顿。大多数人都知道阿森纳当时有多紧张，尤其是阿尔特塔。阿森纳最后在酋长球场作战时——对伯恩利的倒数第二轮——看台上充满了焦虑。他们以1-0艰难过关。
随后曼城战平伯恩茅斯，一切结束了；阿森纳22年的等待，那沉重的枷锁。解放感难以言喻。没人能质疑这支球队的胆魄。没人再能用“又是第二，噢嘞噢嘞”来嘲讽他们。显然，阿尔特塔和弟子们将从中汲取力量，或许还会带来更具攻击性的足球风格。上一次的恐惧让他们在关键时刻畏手畏脚。
阿森纳在幕后做了调整，追求边际效益，最明显的是医疗部门，六月初首席队医扎法尔·伊克巴尔经过双方同意离任，阿尔纳尔多·阿布兰特斯从阿斯顿维拉来投接替他。如果球员们能更长时间保持健康，阿森纳相信自己能保持领先。他们还通过引援来深化本已雄厚的阵容，保护自己。布鲁诺·吉马良斯是最引人注目的新援，埃兹里·孔萨也即将加盟。
阿森纳对曼城仍是主要对决。上赛季瓜迪奥拉对阿尔特塔颇有心得，三战两胜一平。曼城在联赛杯决赛中2-0获胜，表现好得多。但那是在瓜迪奥拉麾下，而且当时有罗德里和伯纳多·席尔瓦。如果说瓜迪奥拉的离去对曼城打击最大，那么两位中场核心分别去了巴塞罗那和皇家马德里也不遑多让。
曼城对新帅恩佐·马雷斯卡的信任源于他在教练组工作时的表现；他是2022-23赛季三冠王时期瓜迪奥拉的助教。此前，他曾率U-23队夺得2020-21赛季英超二级联赛冠军。
这是一次深思熟虑的任命；是运营良好的俱乐部会做出的决定。但与此同时，它并不会让人心跳加速。简单说，马雷斯卡要填补的巨大空缺。埃利奥特·安德森也一样，这位出色的年轻中场是曼城押下重注的球员。在人员流失的情况下，曼城能变得更好吗？鉴于阿森纳的势头，他们肯定必须如此。曼城确实还拥有哈兰德这个作弊代码。
曼城和利物浦有相似之处，利物浦希望新帅安多尼·伊劳拉在首个赛季能产生类似阿内·斯洛特在2024-25赛季的影响。斯洛特接过克洛普的球队，轻松夺冠。也许教练席的连续性并非一切？
另一方面，斯洛特只得到一名新援——费德里科·基耶萨——当季几乎没上场，他基本上坚持了克洛普团队成功的模式。那是进化而非革命。上赛季当他尝试革命时，发现自己的任期瓦解了，尽管必须承认他在伤病方面运气极差。还有若塔的离世。
订阅《每日足球》
用《卫报》对足球世界的看法开启你的夜晚
在简讯推广之后
利物浦已经送走了安迪·罗伯逊、伊布拉希马·科纳特，最关键的是穆罕默德·萨拉赫，即使他已不再是巅峰状态。萨拉赫尚未被替代；要想替代巅峰期的他是不可能的，而伊劳拉面临不少伤病问题，任务艰巨。
从弗洛里安·维尔茨和亚历山大·伊萨克身上挖掘更多是关键。伊劳拉的风格有可能让安菲尔德着迷；那种侵略性、前压的流畅度、全场一对一单挑的胆量。他能多快将其贯彻？
切尔西在哈维·阿隆索手下会很有趣，他获准引进球员来适配他在勒沃库森用过且效果惊人的3-4-2-1阵型。阿隆索也被允许打破俱乐部优先年轻化的引援模式，带来急需的经验。
摩根·罗杰斯与科尔·帕尔默搭档，身后是若昂·佩德罗，莫伊塞斯·凯塞多也许还有里斯·詹姆斯坐镇后腰，这样的组合感觉很不错。中卫位置有天赋。没有欧战暂时是福气。
问任何一位CEO，赛季初球迷想要什么，答案总是一样的：比上赛季更好。这对切尔西来说不是问题，他们上赛季崩盘后仅列第十。或者热刺，他们连续第二季排名第17，惊险保级。罗伯托·德泽尔比在还剩七轮时接手，将他们保了下来，而在丹尼尔·列维近25年主席任期结束后的第一个夏天，新管理层决心果断行动。他们花大价钱引进英超证明过的球员，让球迷可以做梦。
德泽尔比是能激发大家热情的人。他们信任他。中场也将有桑德罗·托纳利和马特乌斯·费尔南德斯。预计康纳·加拉格尔或詹姆斯·麦迪逊会占据10号位，热刺看起来有像样的中场枢纽来支撑大局。他们还受益于没有欧战。
那么曼联呢？今年一月迈克尔·卡里克上任——起初是临时——后一切突然到位。他的战绩让俱乐部必须让他转正——他联赛17场12胜3平。场均2.3分。换算成38轮就是87分。阿森纳以85分夺冠。曼联是夺冠黑马吗？
担忧依然存在。卡里克基本没受伤病困扰，当曼联阵中最强十一人在场时，他们能匹敌任何人。当缺了几个人，正如他们在鲁本·阿莫林手下经常遭遇的，他们就会陷入平淡。曼联今年夏天本来就必须引进不少新援，尤其是他们要准备从无欧战赛季回到欧冠。他们做得还不够；转会窗口剩下的十几天可能至关重要。就像迈克·泰森几乎说过的：每个人都有计划，直到脸上挨了欧冠一拳。
维拉真的能在上赛季排名第四并赢得欧联杯的高光之后更进一步吗？鉴于罗杰斯、尤里·蒂勒曼斯和卢卡斯·迪涅等人的离队，以及孔萨也准备走人，这似乎不太可能。奇怪的是，他们身上有一丝过渡的气息。每支球队都能找到担忧的理由。除了阿森纳。

items.titleEn: Which Arsenal players will be at 2026 World Cup?
items.summaryEn: See who is heading to the tournament in the United States, Mexico and Canada
bodyEn: The line-up for the 2026 World Cup is now complete after a dramatic European play-off round as 48 sides head to Canada, USA and Mexico this summer.
Viktor Gyokeres was the hero in the final international break of 2025/26, netting four times to help Sweden qualify for the World Cup for the first time in eight years.

He joined a host of other stars that have done the hard work and will be appearing in this summer's showpiece event. Let's examine which players have qualified and who they'll face in the finals in North America!
SOUTH AMERICAN SHOWSTOPPERS
Brazil became the first nation to feature our stars to qualify for the World Cup next summer on June 10, 2025.
During the qualification campaign, both Gabriel Martinelli and Gabriel found the net as Brazil qualified for a 23rd consecutive finals with two matchweeks to spare.
Brazil ended on 28 points, enough to finish in the top six places and qualify for the first World Cup to feature 48 teams, up from 32 teams that made up the tournaments from 1998 to 2022.
Joining them from South America is defender Piero Hincapie's Ecuador, who qualified on the same day as Brazil.
Ecuador had a campaign to remember, finishing second in the standings, keeping 13 clean sheets and conceding just five goals in 18 matches.
EURO STARS

There was plenty of success in Europe, where nine players scored to help their nations qualify. England showed their strength by winning all eight group matches without conceding a goal, qualifying with two games to spare.
During qualifying, Bukayo Saka, Declan Rice, Myles Lewis-Skelly, Noni Madueke and Eberechi Eze all found the net to help the Three Lions reach the finals for an eighth time in a row.

Mikel Merino enjoyed a dazzling World Cup qualifying campaign, netting six times as Spain cruised into the World Cup. Martin Zubimendi featured in five of the six matches, scoring in a 4-0 win over Georgia, with David Raya in every matchday squad as the European champions look to go all the way on the world stage next summer.
History was made by Martin Odegaard's Norway, who qualified for a major competition for the first time in 25 years after winning all eight matches in their qualifying group.

Drawn in a group with Riccardo Calafiori's Italy, Martin's country proved too strong for all those around them as Norway scored an incredible 37 times in eight matches to return to the World Cup stage for the first time since 1998.
Elsewhere, William Saliba and France made safe passage to another World Cup. Les Bleus dropped just two points, a draw versus Iceland, in Group D to ensure they finished six points ahead of Ukraine.

Jurrien Timber continued his form this campaign, helping the Netherlands qualify for back-to-back World Cups. Timber started the two November internationals against Poland and Lithuania as Ronald Koeman's side clinched qualification on the final day with a 4-0 win over the Lithuanians in Amsterdam.

In Group J, Leandro Trossard's Belgium also secured their qualification on the last day. Leo scored in a crucial win over Wales in October before coming on as a substitute in the 7-0 win over Liechtenstein to confirm top spot.
While not featuring for Germany in qualifying, Kai Havertz's nation topped Group A thanks to a commanding final day 6-0 win over Slovakia.
VIKTOR'S PLAYOFF HEROICS
There was plenty of drama in the European playoffs as Viktor Gyokeres fired Sweden to the finals for the first time since 2018.
After smashing home a hat-trick in the semi-final against Ukraine, Viktor then took on Poland in a rematch of the 2022 playoff final, which the Poles triumphed.

But it was the Swedes who exacted revenge this time around, with Viktor smashing home a late winner at the Strawberry Arena to ensure the Nordic nation will face Jurrien Timber's Netherlands, Tunisia and Japan at this summer's finals.
WHO WILL FACE EACH OTHER THIS SUMMER?
One of the standout groups of the first 48-team world cup comes in Group E where our captain, Martin Odegaard, will face William Saliba's France.

Wilo played at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar as Les Bleus made it all the way to the final, finishing as runners-up to Argentina. This will be Norway's first World Cup since 1998 after Martin helped Norway finish with a perfect qualifying record.
The pair will face off in the final group game, going head-to-head on June 26, 2026, in Boston.
The two European nations are joined by Senegal, who stunned France in the opening match of the 2002 World Cup in Korea, as well as Iraq.

items.titleZh: 哪些阿森纳球员将参加2026年世界杯？
items.summaryZh: 看看谁将前往美国、墨西哥和加拿大参加世界杯。
bodyZh: 经过戏剧性的欧洲附加赛轮次后，2026年世界杯的参赛球队现已确定，48支球队将于今夏前往加拿大、美国和墨西哥。
维克托·哲凯赖什在2025/26赛季最后一个国际比赛日成为英雄，攻入四球，帮助瑞典队八年来首次获得世界杯参赛资格。
他加入了众多其他球星的行列，这些球星历经艰辛，将亮相今夏的盛会。让我们看看哪些球员已经晋级，以及他们将在北美的决赛中面对哪些对手！
南美焦点
巴西于2025年6月10日成为首个拥有我们球员晋级明年夏天世界杯的国家。
在预选赛中，加布里埃尔·马丁内利和加布里埃尔均取得进球，帮助巴西提前两个比赛日锁定连续第23次进入决赛圈。
巴西最终积28分，足以跻身前六，从而获得首届48队世界杯的入场券。与1998年至2022年由32支球队组成的赛事相比，参赛球队数量有所增加。
来自南美的后卫皮耶罗·因卡皮耶所在的厄瓜多尔队也于同日晋级，与巴西携手出线。
厄瓜多尔经历了一届难忘的预选赛，最终排名第二，在18场比赛中13次零封对手，仅失5球。
欧洲之星
欧洲地区同样捷报频传，九名球员取得进球帮助各自国家队晋级。英格兰队展现强大实力，八场小组赛全胜且一球未失，提前两轮锁定出线名额。
在预选赛中，布卡约·萨卡、德克兰·赖斯、迈尔斯·刘易斯-斯凯利、诺尼·马杜埃凯和埃贝雷奇·埃泽均取得进球，帮助三狮军团连续第八次闯入决赛圈。
米克尔·梅里诺在世界杯预选赛中表现耀眼，打入六球，帮助西班牙轻松晋级世界杯。马丁·祖比门迪在六场比赛中出场五次，在4-0战胜格鲁吉亚的比赛中破门得分，大卫·拉亚则入选每场比赛的大名单。作为欧洲冠军，西班牙队期待明年夏天在世界舞台上全力争冠。
马丁·厄德高所在的挪威队创造了历史，他们在预选赛小组中八战全胜，25年来首次获得重大赛事参赛资格。
挪威与里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里所在的意大利队同组，但马丁的国家队实力超群。挪威在八场比赛中打入惊人的37球，自1998年以来首次重返世界杯舞台。
其他方面，威廉·萨利巴所在的法国队顺利晋级又一届世界杯。高卢雄鸡在D组仅丢两分——战平冰岛，最终确保以领先乌克兰6分的成绩出线。
尤里安·廷伯延续了本赛季的出色状态，帮助荷兰队连续两届世界杯晋级。廷伯在11月对阵波兰和立陶宛的两场国际比赛中首发出场，最终罗纳德·科曼的球队在最后一天于阿姆斯特丹4-0大胜立陶宛，锁定出线资格。
在J组，莱安德罗·特罗萨德所在的比利时队也在最后一天锁定了晋级资格。特罗萨德在10月对威尔士的关键胜利中进球，随后在对列支敦士登的7-0大胜中替补登场，确认了小组头名位置。
尽管凯·哈弗茨在预选赛中未代表德国队出场，但德国队凭借最后一天6-0大胜斯洛伐克的统治性表现，排名A组第一。
维克托的附加赛英雄壮举
欧洲附加赛充满戏剧性，维克托·哲凯赖什率瑞典队自2018年以来首次闯入决赛圈。
在附加赛半决赛对阵乌克兰上演帽子戏法后，维克托又在附加赛决赛中遭遇波兰队，这是2022年附加赛决赛的重演，当时波兰队获胜。
不过这次是瑞典人复仇成功，维克托在草莓竞技场打入绝杀球，确保这个北欧国家将在今夏决赛中对阵尤里安·廷伯的荷兰队、突尼斯队和日本队。
今夏谁将对阵谁？
首届48队世界杯中，E组格外引人注目，我们的队长马丁·厄德高将迎战威廉·萨利巴所在的法国队。
维洛（萨利巴昵称）曾参加2022年卡塔尔世界杯，当时法国队一路闯入决赛，最终负于阿根廷获得亚军。在马丁帮助挪威队以完美预选赛战绩晋级后，这将是挪威队自1998年以来首次参加世界杯。
两队将在小组赛最后一轮正面交锋，比赛于2026年6月26日在波士顿举行。
这两支欧洲球队所在的小组中还有塞内加尔和伊拉克。塞内加尔曾在2002年韩日世界杯揭幕战上爆冷击败法国。

items.summaryEn: Watch the best of the action from the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium as we thumped our rivals for the second time this season
bodyEn: For the second time this season, we beat Tottenham Hotspur 4-1 as we got back to winning ways in the Premier League in style, and you can enjoy it all over again with our highlights.

Having netted a hat-trick against our neighbours back in November, Ebere Eze was at it again as he opened the scoring, and while we were swiftly pegged back by Randal Kolo Muani, Viktor Gyokeres put us back in front not long after half-time.

Eze then bagged his fifth of the season against Spurs, before our Swedish striker also completed his brace in stoppage time as he powered his way to goal, and put the icing on top of a big result which secured the derby day bragging rights for our Gooners once again, and re-established our five-point lead at the top of the table.

bodyZh: 本赛季第二次，我们以4-1击败托特纳姆热刺，以华丽的方式重返英超胜利轨道，您可以再次通过集锦回味这一切。
去年11月我们对邻居上演帽子戏法的埃贝雷·埃泽再次首开纪录，尽管兰德尔·科洛·穆阿尼迅速扳平，但维克托·哲凯赖什在半场不久后帮助我们再度领先。
埃泽随后攻入他本赛季对阵热刺的第五球，而我们的瑞典前锋也在补时阶段完成梅开二度，强势破门，为这场大胜锦上添花，再次为枪手赢得德比日的荣耀，并重新确立了我们积分榜上五分的领先优势。

items.titleEn: Highlights: Wolves 2-2 Arsenal
items.summaryEn: Watch the best of the action from our Premier League game at Molineux
bodyEn: We were pegged back late on at Molineux on Wednesday as Wolverhampton Wanderers fought back from 2-0 down to gain a point, and you can watch the key moments now with our highlights.
Bukayo Saka headed us into an early lead, with Piero Hincapie adding a second after the break after VAR corrected the referee's on-field decision to give the Ecuadorian his first Gunners goal.

But just as it looked like we were set for a big three points, Hugo Bueno got one back for Wolves shortly afterwards, before Tom Edozie levelled in second-half stoppage time with a shot that crept in off Riccardo Calafiori.
You can watch a short edit of the action by pressing play on the video above, with an extended cut and a full match replay to follow soon.

bodyZh: 周三在莫利纽克斯，我们在比赛末段被追平，狼队从0-2落后扳回一球，最终拿到一分。现在你可以通过我们的集锦观看关键瞬间。
布卡约·萨卡头球帮助我们取得领先，皮耶罗·因卡皮耶在中场休息后打入第二球，此前VAR纠正了裁判的场上判罚，让这位厄瓜多尔人收获了他的首个阿森纳进球。
但就在看起来我们将要收获重要的三分时，乌戈·布埃诺很快为狼队扳回一球，随后托马斯·埃多齐在补时阶段射门，皮球在里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里身上折射入网，将比分扳平。

items.titleEn: Go Inside Training ahead of trip to Wolves
bodyEn: We'll be looking to extend our lead at the top of the Premier League when we face Wolves at Molineux on Wednesday night, and you can see what we've been up to in training ahead of the game with Inside Training.

We head into the contest holding a four-point lead at the top of the league, but with no other league matches taking place this midweek, we can extend our lead to seven with victory over Rob Edwards' side.

While our last Premier League game saw us held to a frustrating 1-1 draw against Brentford, we come into Wednesday's game in winning form having comfortably beaten Wigan Athletic 4-0 in the FA Cup on Sunday.
To see what we've been up to at the Sobha Realty Training Centre ahead of our trip to the Black Country, press play on the video at the top of the article.

items.titleZh: 备战狼队：训练幕后
items.summaryZh: 阿森纳周三客场挑战狼队，目前领先四分，取胜可扩大优势。
bodyZh: 我们将在周三晚于莫利纽球场对阵狼队，力争扩大英超积分榜上的领先优势。在赛前，你可以通过本期《训练幕后》了解我们最近的备战情况。
目前我们在积分榜上以四分优势领跑，由于本周中其他球队没有联赛安排，如果我们能战胜罗布·爱德华兹的球队，领先优势将扩大到七分。
尽管我们上一场英超联赛被布伦特福德1-1逼平令人失望，但我们在周日的足总杯中4-0大胜维冈竞技，以胜利之姿迎接周中的比赛。
点击文章顶部的视频，观看我们在索巴房地产训练中心的备战画面，准备前往黑乡。

items.titleEn: Inside Training: Locking in for Leuven
bodyEn: We hold a 4-0 advantage in our UEFA Women's Champions League tie against OH Leuven, and you can see how we've been preparing for the second leg with the latest edition of Inside Training.

A blistering performance in Belgium saw us put one foot into the quarter-finals as a brace from Frida Maanum as well as goals from Olivia Smith and Alessia Russo gave us a commanding lead to bring back to north London.

With Chelsea awaiting the winners of the tie in a potentially mouth-watering quarter-final, we'll be looking to finish the job at Mangata Developments Stadium against a Leuven side we've already beaten twice in this year's competition.
To see what Renée Slegers' side have been up to at the Sobha Realty Training Centre this week, press play on the video at the top of the article.

切尔西可能在四分之一决赛中等待本场胜者，这将是一场诱人的对决，我们希望在曼加塔发展球场完成任务，对手是本赛季已在赛事中两次击败的鲁汶队。

items.titleEn: Highlights: OH Leuven 0-4 Arsenal Women
bodyEn: We produced a dominant display in Belgium to thrash OH Leuven 4-0 in the first leg of our UEFA Women's Champions League quarter-final playoff, and you can watch highlights from our success.
Frida Maanum opened the scoring with a header from close range before Olivia Smith finished off a flowing team move.
We continued where we left off after the break, and Frida once again made no mistake from close range to make it three, before Alessia Russo complete the rout with a powerful strike.

items.titleEn: Arteta's positive fitness update ahead of Forest
items.summaryEn: Mikel Arteta issued a positive injury update ahead of our Premier League contest against Nottingham Forest at the City Ground
bodyEn: Mikel Arteta reported that there are no fresh injury concerns ahead of our trip to face Nottingham Forest on Saturday, January 17.

After back-to-back wins in cup competitions over Portsmouth and Chelsea, we return to league action at the City Ground, and the boss is hoping to welcome back some of those who have been sidelined so far in 2026.
“It might be (time),” Mikel said at the Sobha Realty Training Centre on Friday, “I need to meet now with the medical staff.
“We have a training session now and we’ll see if somebody is available for the weekend.”
Asked if there was anyone in particular who may become available, the boss said that he wouldn’t know until after the training session following his press conference.

The majority of our current injuries are to defenders, with Piero Hincapie being forced off in our last league game against Liverpool, while Riccardo Calafiori and Cristhian Mosquera have been out since 2025.
Despite these being among many other defensive injuries this season, we haven’t conceded three times in a single game since December 2023 in a 4-3 win away to Luton Town.
Mikel pointed to our organisation and desire as the reasons for this outstanding record.

“With the right level of organisation, but especially with the desire to play, shown every day, and the commitment that they show to do all the duties that are necessary for us to be a team that is very difficult to play against and to score against.”

items.titleZh: 阿尔特塔在森林赛前发布乐观伤情更新
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔在客场对阵诺丁汉森林前更新了球队伤情。
bodyZh: 米克尔·阿尔特塔表示，在1月17日星期六客场对阵诺丁汉森林之前，球队没有新的伤病问题。
在杯赛中连续战胜朴茨茅斯和切尔西之后，我们将在城市球场重返联赛，主教练希望迎回一些在2026年至今一直缺阵的球员。
“也许时候到了，”米克尔周五在苏哈房地产训练中心说道，“我现在需要与医疗团队会面。”
“我们现在有一堂训练课，我们会看看是否有人能在周末出场。”
当被问及是否有特定球员可能复出时，主教练表示，在新闻发布会后的训练课结束之前他不会知道。
我们目前的大多数伤病都集中在后卫身上，皮耶罗·欣卡皮在上一场对阵利物浦的联赛中被换下，而里卡尔多·卡拉菲奥里和克里斯蒂安·莫斯克拉自2025年以来一直缺阵。
尽管本赛季多次遭遇防守伤病，但自2023年12月客场4-3战胜卢顿以来，我们还没有在单场比赛中丢过三球。
米克尔将这一出色记录归功于我们的组织性和渴望。
“凭借正确的组织水平，尤其是每天展现出的比赛渴望，以及他们为履行所有必要职责所付出的承诺，这使我们成为一支很难被对抗和攻破的球队。”
